   226	
   227	class PackValidator:
   228	    """Validates an external pack directory statically."""
   229	
   230	    def __init__(self, pack_root: Path):
   231	        self.pack_root = pack_root.resolve()
   232	        self.errors: list[str] = []
   233	        self.warnings: list[str] = []
   234	        self._pack_data: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None
   235	        self._layout_issues: list[LayoutValidationIssue] = []
   236	        self._layout_exceptions: list[PackLayoutException] = []
   237	
   238	    def validate(self) -> list[str]:
   239	        """Run all validations. Returns list of error strings (empty = valid)."""
   240	        self.errors = []
   241	        self.warnings = []
   242	        self._layout_issues = []
   243	        self._layout_exceptions = []
   244	        self._capability_locations: dict[str, str] = {}
   245	        self._pack_capability_locations: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {
   246	            kind: {} for kind in PACK_ALIAS_KINDS
   247	        }
   248	        self._alias_targets: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []
   249	        self._pack_alias_resolvers: dict[str, AliasResolver] = {
   250	            kind: AliasResolver() for kind in PACK_ALIAS_KINDS
   251	        }
   252	        self._pack_alias_targets: list[tuple[str, str, str, str]] = []
   253	
   254	        if (self.pack_root / ".no-pack").exists():
   255	            return self.errors
   256	
   257	        pack_yaml = pack_manifest_path(self.pack_root)
   258	        if pack_yaml is None:
   259	            self.errors.append(
   260	                f"{self._rel(self.pack_root)}: pack manifest not found "
   261	                f"(pack.yaml, pack.yml, or pack.json)"
   262	            )
   263	            return self.errors
   264	
   265	        # Parse pack.yaml
   266	        pack_data = self._load_yaml(pack_yaml)
   267	        if pack_data is None:
   268	            return self.errors  # parse error already recorded
   269	        self._pack_data = pack_data
   270	
   271	        # Check schema_version and validate against JSON Schema
   272	        version = self._validate_manifest(
   273	            pack_data, "pack", self._rel(pack_yaml)
   274	        )
   275	        if version is None:
   276	            return self.errors  # schema_version error already recorded
   277	
   278	        self._validate_pack_taxonomy()
   279	
   280	        # Validate content roots exist
   281	        content = pack_data.get("content", {})
   282	        if isinstance(content, dict):
   283	            self._validate_content_roots(content)
   284	
   285	        # Validate docs exist
   286	        docs = pack_data.get("docs", {})
   287	        if isinstance(docs, dict):
   288	            self._validate_docs(docs)
   289	
   290	        # Validate component manifests
   291	        self._validate_components(content)
   292	        self._validate_pack_aliases()
   293	        self._validate_alias_targets()
   294	        self._validate_layout_contract()
   295	        self._flush_layout_issues()
   296	
   297	        return self.errors
   298	
   299	    def validate_component_manifest(
   300	        self,
   301	        manifest_path: str | Path,
   302	        manifest_kind: str,
   303	    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
   304	        """Load and schema-validate one component manifest.
   305	
   306	        This uses the same parsing and JSON Schema path as full pack validation,
   307	        without requiring callers to validate a whole pack tree.
   308	        """
   309	        path = Path(manifest_path)
   310	        data = self._load_yaml(path)
   311	        if data is None:
   312	            return None
   313	        self._validate_manifest(data, manifest_kind, self._rel(path))
   314	        return data
   315	
   316	    def _load_yaml(
   317	        self,
   318	        path: Path,
   319	        *,
   320	        manifest_kind: str = "pack",
   321	    ) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:
   322	        """Load a YAML file with safe_load. Returns None on error."""
   323	        rel = self._rel(path)
   324	        try:
   325	            data = load_manifest_mapping(path, manifest_kind=manifest_kind)
   326	        except ManifestParseError as e:
   327	            self.errors.append(f"{rel}: {e}")
   328	            return None
   329	
   330	        return data
   331	
   332	    def _validate_manifest(
   333	        self,
   334	        data: dict[str, Any],
   335	        manifest_kind: str,
   336	        relpath: str,
   337	    ) -> Optional[int]:
   338	        """Validate a manifest dict against its JSON Schema.
   339	
   340	        Returns the schema_version on success, None on failure.
   341	        """
   342	        # Pack and component manifests are schema-versioned. If a component
   343	        # omits schema_version, validate against v1 so the schema reports the
   344	        # same missing-field error direct JSON Schema validation would report.
   345	        if "schema_version" not in data:
   346	            if manifest_kind == "pack":
   347	                self.errors.append(f"{relpath}: missing required field schema_version")
   348	                return None
   349	            version = 1
   350	        else:
   351	            try:
   352	                version = _check_schema_version(data["schema_version"], relpath)
   353	            except ValidationError as e:
   354	                self.errors.append(str(e))
   355	                return None
   356	
   357	        # Load and validate against JSON Schema
   358	        schema_path = KNOWN_SCHEMA_VERSIONS[version].get(manifest_kind)
   359	        if schema_path is None:
   360	            self.errors.append(
   361	                f"{relpath}: no schema for {manifest_kind} in version {version}"
   362	            )
   363	            return None
   364	
   365	        try:
   366	            schema, registry = self._load_schema(schema_path, manifest_kind, version)
   367	        except Exception as e:
   368	            self.errors.append(
   369	                f"{relpath}: cannot load schema {schema_path} — {e}"
   370	            )
   371	            return None
   372	
   373	        validator = jsonschema.Draft7Validator(schema, registry=registry)
   374	        raw_errors = list(validator.iter_errors(data))
   375	        raw_errors = self._filter_dynamic_element_kind_errors(
   376	            raw_errors,
   377	            data=data,
   378	            manifest_kind=manifest_kind,
   379	        )
   380	
   381	        if raw_errors:
   382	            # Take the first few errors to avoid overwhelming output
   383	            for err in raw_errors[:5]:
   384	                self.errors.append(
   385	                    _normalize_jsonschema_error(err, relpath, data)
   386	                )
   387	            if len(raw_errors) > 5:
   388	                self.errors.append(
   389	                    f"{relpath}: ... and {len(raw_errors) - 5} more validation errors"
   390	                )
   391	            return None
   392	
   393	        return version
   394	
   395	    def _filter_dynamic_element_kind_errors(
   396	        self,
   397	        errors: list[jsonschema.ValidationError],
   398	        *,
   399	        data: dict[str, Any],
   400	        manifest_kind: str,
   401	    ) -> list[jsonschema.ValidationError]:
   402	        if manifest_kind != "element" or self._pack_data is None:
   403	            return errors
   404	        kind_value = data.get("kind")
   405	        if not isinstance(kind_value, str):
   406	            return errors
   407	        try:
   408	            pack = self._pack_definition_for_discovery({})
   409	            element_kind_registry_for_pack(pack).normalize(kind_value)
   410	        except Exception:
   411	            return errors
   412	        return [
   413	            error
   414	            for error in errors
   415	            if not (error.validator == "enum" and list(error.absolute_path) == ["kind"])
   416	        ]
   417	
   418	    def _load_schema(
   419	        self, schema_path: Path, manifest_kind: str, version: int
   420	    ) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], Registry]:
   421	        """Load a JSON Schema file and build a referencing.Registry.
   422	
   423	        Returns (schema_dict, registry) for use with jsonschema validators.
   424	        Cached per (manifest_kind, version).
   425	        """
   426	        schema_key = (manifest_kind, version)
   427	        if not hasattr(self, "_schema_cache"):
   428	            self._schema_cache: dict[tuple, tuple[dict[str, Any], Registry]] = {}
   429	        if schema_key in self._schema_cache:
   430	            return self._schema_cache[schema_key]
   431	
   432	        # Load the _defs.json first
   433	        defs_path = schema_path.parent / "_defs.json"
   434	        registry = Registry()
   435	        if defs_path.is_file():
   436	            with open(defs_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
   437	                defs_schema = json_loads(f.read())
   438	            registry = registry.with_resource(
   439	                "_defs.json", Resource.from_contents(defs_schema)
   440	            )
   441	
   442	        # Load the schema
   443	        with open(schema_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
   444	            schema = json_loads(f.read())
   445	
   446	        # Also register the schema itself if it has an $id
   447	        schema_id = schema.get("$id")
   448	        if schema_id:
   449	            registry = registry.with_resource(
   450	                schema_id, Resource.from_contents(schema)
   451	            )
   452	
   453	        self._schema_cache[schema_key] = (schema, registry)
   454	
   455	        return schema, registry
   456	
   457	    def _validate_content_roots(self, content: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   458	        """Verify that declared content root directories exist.
   459	
   460	        Missing ``executors``, ``orchestrators``, or ``elements`` directories
   461	        are hard errors. Missing ``schemas`` or ``examples`` directories are
   462	        warnings.
   463	        """
   464	        supported = {"executors", "orchestrators", "elements", "schemas", "examples", "docs"}
   465	        for key in sorted(set(content) - supported):
   466	            self.warnings.append(
   467	                f"pack.yaml: unsupported content root {key!r}"
   468	            )
   469	        _hard_roots = {"executors", "orchestrators", "elements"}
   470	        for key in ("executors", "orchestrators", "elements", "schemas", "examples"):
   471	            if key not in content:
   472	                continue
   473	            root_rel = content[key]
   474	            if not isinstance(root_rel, str) or not root_rel.strip():
   475	                continue
   476	            root_path = self.pack_root / root_rel
   477	            if not root_path.is_dir():
   478	                if key in _hard_roots:
   479	                    self.errors.append(
   480	                        f"{self._rel(root_path)}/: declared content root {key!r} does not exist"
   481	                    )
   482	                else:
   483	                    self.warnings.append(
   484	                        f"{self._rel(root_path)}/: declared content root does not exist"
   485	                    )
   486	
   487	    def _validate_pack_taxonomy(self) -> None:
   488	        if self._pack_data is None:
   489	            return
   490	        for field, allowed in _PACK_TAXONOMY_ENUMS.items():
   491	            value = self._pack_data.get(field)
   492	            if value is None or value == "":
   493	                continue
   494	            if not isinstance(value, str):
   495	                continue
   496	            if value not in allowed:
   497	                self.errors.append(
   498	                    f"pack.yaml: {field} must be one of {list(allowed)}, got {value!r}"
   499	                )
   500	
   501	    def _validate_docs(self, docs: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   502	        """Verify that declared doc files exist."""
   503	        for doc_key, doc_rel in docs.items():
   504	            if not isinstance(doc_rel, str) or not doc_rel.strip():
   505	                continue
   506	            doc_path = self.pack_root / doc_rel
   507	            if not doc_path.is_file():
   508	                self.warnings.append(
   509	                    f"{self._rel(doc_path)}: declared docs file not found"
   510	                )
   511	
   512	    def _validate_components(self, content: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   513	        """Validate all component manifests declared via content roots."""
   514	        if self._pack_data is None:
   515	            return
   516	        self._validate_discovered_components(content)

   520	        status = str(data.get("status") or "active")

   518	    def _pack_definition_for_discovery(self, content: dict[str, Any]) -> PackDefinition:
   519	        data = self._pack_data or {}
   520	        status = str(data.get("status") or "active")
   521	        taxonomy = pack_taxonomy_from_manifest(data, status=status)
   522	        return PackDefinition(

   525	            version=str(data.get("version") or ""),
   526	            root=self.pack_root,
   527	            manifest_path=self.pack_root / "pack.yaml",
   528	            schema_version=data.get("schema_version"),
   529	            description=str(data.get("description") or ""),
   530	            status=status,
   531	            visibility=str(data.get("visibility") or "visible"),
   532	            content=dict(content),
   533	            metadata=dict(data.get("metadata", {})) if isinstance(data.get("metadata", {}), dict) else {},
   534	            agent=dict(data.get("agent", {})) if isinstance(data.get("agent", {}), dict) else {},
   535	            aliases=_optional_pack_aliases(data.get("aliases"), path="pack.aliases"),
   536	            permissions=_normalize_pack_permissions(data.get("permissions")),
   537	            extensions=_optional_pack_extensions(data.get("extensions"), path="pack.extensions"),
   538	            **taxonomy,
   539	        )

   541	    def _validate_discovered_components(self, content: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   542	        pack = self._pack_definition_for_discovery(content)
   543	        for comp_dir in iter_executor_roots(pack):
   544	            manifest_path = find_component_manifest(comp_dir, "executor")
   545	            if manifest_path is not None:
   546	                self._validate_component_manifest_file(
   547	                    pack, comp_dir, manifest_path, "executor"
   548	                )
   549	        for comp_dir in iter_orchestrator_roots(pack):
   550	            manifest_path = find_component_manifest(comp_dir, "orchestrator")
   551	            if manifest_path is not None:
   552	                self._validate_component_manifest_file(
   553	                    pack, comp_dir, manifest_path, "orchestrator"
   554	                )
   555	        for kind, elem_dir in iter_element_roots(pack):
   556	            manifest_path = find_component_manifest(elem_dir, "element")
   557	            if manifest_path is not None:
   558	                self._validate_element_manifest_file(pack, kind, manifest_path)
   559	        try:
   560	            rendering_manifest_paths = pack_rendering_manifest_paths(pack)
   561	        except PackValidationError as exc:
   562	            self.errors.append(f"pack.yaml: {exc}")
   563	            return
   564	        for manifest_kind, manifest_paths in zip(
   565	            _RENDERING_MANIFEST_KINDS,
   566	            rendering_manifest_paths,
   567	        ):
   568	            for manifest_path in manifest_paths:
   569	                self._validate_rendering_manifest_file(
   570	                    pack,
   571	                    manifest_path,
   572	                    manifest_kind,
   573	                )

   575	    def _validate_rendering_manifest_file(
   576	        self,
   577	        pack: PackDefinition,
   578	        manifest_path: Path,
   579	        manifest_kind: str,
   580	    ) -> None:
   581	        data = self._load_yaml(manifest_path, manifest_kind=manifest_kind)
   582	        if data is None:
   583	            return
   584	
   585	        rel = self._rel(manifest_path)
   586	        version = self._validate_manifest(data, manifest_kind, rel)
   587	        if version is None:
   588	            return
   589	        capability_id = data.get("id")
   590	        if not isinstance(capability_id, str):
   591	            return
   592	        self._register_capability_id(capability_id, rel)
   593	        self._pack_capability_locations[manifest_kind][capability_id] = rel
   594	        try:
   595	            validate_content_id_in_pack(
   596	                capability_id,
   597	                pack,
   598	                content_type=manifest_kind,
   599	            )
   600	        except ValueError as exc:
   601	            self.errors.append(f"{rel}: {exc}")
   602	
   603	    def _validate_component_manifest_file(
   604	        self,
   605	        pack: PackDefinition,
   606	        component_dir: Path,
   607	        manifest_path: Path,
   608	        manifest_kind: str,
   609	    ) -> None:
   610	        data = self._load_yaml(manifest_path)
   611	        if data is None:
   612	            return
   613	
   614	        rel = self._rel(manifest_path)
   615	        version = self._validate_manifest(data, manifest_kind, rel)
   616	        if version is None:
   617	            return
   618	        component_id = data.get("id")
   619	        if isinstance(component_id, str):
   620	            self._register_capability_id(component_id, rel)
   621	            if manifest_kind in self._pack_capability_locations:
   622	                self._pack_capability_locations[manifest_kind][component_id] = rel
   623	            self._register_aliases(data, rel)
   624	            try:
   625	                validate_content_id_in_pack(
   626	                    component_id,
   627	                    pack,
   628	                    content_type=manifest_kind,
   629	                )
   630	            except ValueError as exc:
   631	                self.errors.append(f"{rel}: {exc}")
   632	
   633	        self._validate_runtime_entrypoints(component_dir, data, manifest_kind, rel)
   634	        self._validate_runtime_definition(data, manifest_kind, rel)
   635	
   636	        docs = data.get("docs", {})
   637	        stage = docs.get("stage", "STAGE.md") if isinstance(docs, dict) else "STAGE.md"
   638	        stage_path = component_dir / stage
   639	        if not stage_path.is_file():
   640	            self.warnings.append(f"{self._rel(stage_path)}: STAGE.md not found")
   641	
   642	    def _validate_runtime_definition(
   643	        self, data: dict[str, Any], manifest_kind: str, rel: str
   644	    ) -> None:
   645	        """Run the pack-tier runtime-reconciliation check after the JSON-Schema pass.
   646	
   647	        The JSON Schema is permissive about shapes the runtime parser rejects
   648	        (e.g. a manifest declaring its runtime module twice with conflicting
   649	        values). That structural check lives in the pack tier
   650	        (``reconcile_runtime_module``); the executor / orchestrator schemas call
   651	        the same helper at registry-load time, so running it here keeps
   652	        ``packs validate`` parity without importing those upper tiers.
   653	        """
   654	        if manifest_kind == "executor":
   655	            if isinstance(data, dict) and isinstance(data.get("executors"), list):
   656	                items = data["executors"]
   657	            else:
   658	                items = [data]
   659	            for item in items:
   660	                self._reconcile_runtime_module(item, "executor", rel)
   661	        elif manifest_kind == "orchestrator":
   662	            self._reconcile_runtime_module(data, "orchestrator", rel)
   663	
   664	    def _reconcile_runtime_module(
   665	        self, data: Any, component: str, rel: str
   666	    ) -> None:
   667	        """Apply the pack-tier runtime-module reconciliation check to one manifest."""
   668	        if not isinstance(data, dict):
   669	            return
   670	        metadata = data.get("metadata", {})
   671	        if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
   672	            return
   673	        try:
   674	            reconcile_runtime_module(
   675	                data.get("runtime"), metadata, ValidationError, component
   676	            )
   677	        except ValidationError as exc:
   678	            self.errors.append(f"{rel}: {exc}")
   679	
   680	    def _validate_element_manifest_file(
   681	        self,
   682	        pack: PackDefinition,
   683	        kind: str,
   684	        manifest_path: Path,
   685	    ) -> None:
   686	        data = self._load_yaml(manifest_path)
   687	        if data is None:
   688	            return
   689	
   690	        rel = self._rel(manifest_path)
   691	        version = self._validate_manifest(data, "element", rel)
   692	        if version is None:
   693	            return
   694	        element_id = data.get("id")
   695	        if isinstance(element_id, str):
   696	            self._register_capability_id(f"{kind}/{element_id}", rel)
   697	            self._register_aliases(data, rel)
   698	        try:
   699	            validate_element_pack_id(
   700	                data.get("pack_id"),
   701	                pack,
   702	                element_root=manifest_path.parent,
   703	            )
   704	        except ValueError as exc:
   705	            self.errors.append(f"{rel}: {exc}")
   706	
   707	    def _validate_runtime_entrypoints(
   708	        self,
   709	        component_dir: Path,
   710	        data: dict[str, Any],
   711	        manifest_kind: str,
   712	        rel: str,
   713	    ) -> None:
   714	        if manifest_kind == "executor":
   715	            self._check_runtime_entrypoint(component_dir, data.get("entrypoint"), "entrypoint")
   716	            runtime = data.get("runtime", {})
   717	            if isinstance(runtime, dict):
   718	                self._check_runtime_entrypoint(component_dir, runtime.get("entrypoint"), "runtime entrypoint")
   719	                self._check_command_entrypoint(component_dir, runtime.get("command"))
   720	            self._check_command_entrypoint(component_dir, data.get("command"))
   721	            self._check_metadata_runtime_file(component_dir, data)
   722	            return
   723	
   724	        if manifest_kind != "orchestrator":
   725	            return
   726	
   727	        runtime = data.get("runtime", {})
   728	        if not isinstance(runtime, dict):
   729	            return
   730	        kind = runtime.get("kind")
   731	        if kind == "python":
   732	            self._check_python_module(component_dir, runtime.get("module"), rel, "runtime.module")
   733	        elif kind == "command":
   734	            self._check_command_entrypoint(component_dir, runtime.get("command"))
   735	
   736	    def _check_runtime_entrypoint(self, component_dir: Path, value: Any, label: str) -> None:
   737	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
   738	            return
   739	        if "{" in value or "}" in value:
   740	            return
   741	        entrypoint_path = component_dir / value
   742	        if not entrypoint_path.is_file():
   743	            self.errors.append(f"{self._rel(entrypoint_path)}: {label} file not found")
   744	
   745	    def _check_metadata_runtime_file(self, component_dir: Path, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   746	        metadata = data.get("metadata", {})
   747	        if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
   748	            return
   749	        self._check_runtime_entrypoint(component_dir, metadata.get("runtime_file"), "metadata.runtime_file")
   750	        self._check_python_module(
   751	            component_dir,
   752	            metadata.get("runtime_module"),
   753	            self._rel(component_dir),
   754	            "metadata.runtime_module",
   755	        )
   756	
   757	    def _check_command_entrypoint(self, component_dir: Path, command: Any) -> None:
   758	        if isinstance(command, dict):
   759	            argv = command.get("argv")
   760	        else:
   761	            argv = command
   762	        if not isinstance(argv, list):
   763	            return
   764	        parts = [part for part in argv if isinstance(part, str)]
   765	        for index, part in enumerate(parts):
   766	            if part == "-m" and index + 1 < len(parts):
   767	                self._check_python_module(
   768	                    component_dir,
   769	                    parts[index + 1],
   770	                    self._rel(component_dir),
   771	                    "command.argv module",
   772	                )
   773	                return
   774	        for part in parts:
   775	            if not self._looks_like_local_entrypoint(part):
   776	                continue
   777	            self._check_runtime_entrypoint(component_dir, part, "command.argv entrypoint")
   778	            return
   779	
   780	    def _looks_like_local_entrypoint(self, value: str) -> bool:
   781	        if not value or value.startswith("-") or "{" in value or "}" in value:
   782	            return False
   783	        return value.endswith(".py") or "/" in value or "\\" in value
   784	
   785	    def _check_python_module(
   786	        self,
   787	        component_dir: Path,
   788	        module: Any,
   789	        rel: str,
   790	        label: str,
   791	    ) -> None:
   792	        if not isinstance(module, str) or not module.strip():
   793	            return
   794	        if "{" in module or "}" in module:
   795	            return
   796	        module_path = self._module_path(component_dir, module)
   797	        if module_path is None:
   798	            return
   799	        if not module_path.is_file():
   800	            self.errors.append(
   801	                f"{rel}: {label} file not found for module {module!r}: {self._rel(module_path)}"
   802	            )
   803	
   804	    def _module_path(self, component_dir: Path, module: str) -> Path | None:
   805	        parts = module.split(".")
   806	        pack_id = self._pack_data.get("id") if self._pack_data is not None else None
   807	        if (
   808	            len(parts) >= 6
   809	            and parts[0:2] == ["astrid", "packs"]
   810	            and parts[2] == pack_id
   811	            and parts[3] in {"executors", "orchestrators"}
   812	            and parts[4] == component_dir.name
   813	        ):
   814	            return component_dir / Path(*parts[5:]).with_suffix(".py")
   815	        if (
   816	            len(parts) >= 4
   817	            and parts[0] == pack_id
   818	            and parts[1] in {"executors", "orchestrators"}
   819	            and parts[2] == component_dir.name
   820	        ):
   821	            return self.pack_root / Path(*parts[1:]).with_suffix(".py")
   822	        if (
   823	            len(parts) >= 5
   824	            and parts[0:2] == ["astrid", "packs"]
   825	            and parts[2] == pack_id
   826	            and parts[3] == component_dir.name
   827	        ):
   828	            return component_dir / Path(*parts[4:]).with_suffix(".py")
   829	        if len(parts) >= 5 and parts[0:2] == ["astrid", "packs"]:
   830	            pack_root = _REPO_ROOT / "astrid" / "packs" / parts[2]
   831	            component_name = parts[3]
   832	            tail = Path(*parts[4:]).with_suffix(".py")
   833	            for kind_root in ("executors", "orchestrators"):
   834	                candidate = pack_root / kind_root / component_name / tail
   835	                if candidate.is_file():
   836	                    return candidate
   837	        if module.startswith("astrid."):
   838	            return _REPO_ROOT / Path(*module.split(".")).with_suffix(".py")
   839	        if "." not in module:
   840	            return component_dir / f"{module}.py"
   841	        return component_dir / Path(*module.split(".")).with_suffix(".py")
   842	
   843	    def _register_capability_id(self, capability_id: str, relpath: str) -> None:
   844	        existing = self._capability_locations.get(capability_id)
   845	        if existing is not None:
   846	            self.errors.append(
   847	                f"{relpath}: duplicate capability id {capability_id!r}; already declared in {existing}"
   848	            )
   849	            return
   850	        self._capability_locations[capability_id] = relpath
   851	
   852	    def _register_aliases(self, data: dict[str, Any], relpath: str) -> None:
   853	        metadata = data.get("metadata", {})
   854	        if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
   855	            return
   856	        aliases = metadata.get("aliases", [])
   857	        if not isinstance(aliases, list):
   858	            self.errors.append(f"{relpath}: metadata.aliases must be an array")
   859	            return
   860	        for index, alias in enumerate(aliases):
   861	            if isinstance(alias, str):
   862	                self._alias_targets.append((relpath, f"metadata.aliases[{index}]", alias))
   863	            elif isinstance(alias, dict):
   864	                target = alias.get("canonical_id") or alias.get("target") or alias.get("id")
   865	                if isinstance(target, str):
   866	                    self._alias_targets.append((relpath, f"metadata.aliases[{index}]", target))
   867	                else:
   868	                    self.errors.append(f"{relpath}: metadata.aliases[{index}] must declare canonical_id")
   869	            else:
   870	                self.errors.append(f"{relpath}: metadata.aliases[{index}] must be a string or object")
   871	
   872	    def _validate_pack_aliases(self) -> None:
   873	        if self._pack_data is None:
   874	            return
   875	        aliases = self._pack_data.get("aliases")
   876	        if aliases is None:
   877	            return
   878	        try:
   879	            normalized_aliases = _optional_pack_aliases(aliases, path="pack.aliases")
   880	        except ValueError as exc:
   881	            self.errors.append(f"pack.yaml: {exc}")
   882	            return
   883	
   884	        for index, alias in enumerate(normalized_aliases):
   885	            kind = str(alias["kind"])
   886	            alias_id = str(alias["alias"])
   887	            canonical_id = str(alias["canonical_id"])
   888	            resolver = self._pack_alias_resolvers[kind]
   889	            if resolver.is_alias(alias_id):
   890	                self.errors.append(
   891	                    f"pack.yaml: pack.aliases[{index}] duplicates existing {kind} alias {alias_id!r}"
   892	                )
   893	                continue
   894	            try:
   895	                resolver.register_alias(
   896	                    alias_id,
   897	                    canonical_id,
   898	                    deprecated=bool(alias.get("deprecated", False)),
   899	                    deprecation_message=str(alias.get("deprecation_message", "")),
   900	                )
     1	"""Pack layout contract validation.
     2	
     3	Extracted from ``astrid.core.pack.validate`` during M4 T26.
     4	Provides layout exception types, canonical layout rules, and standalone
     5	validation functions that PackValidator delegates to.

     8	from __future__ import annotations
     9	
    10	from dataclasses import dataclass
    11	from enum import Enum
    12	from pathlib import PurePosixPath
    13	from typing import Any

    16	class LayoutExceptionClass(str, Enum):
    17	    """Named exceptions the pack layout contract allows temporarily or permanently."""
    18	
    19	    IMPORTABLE_COMPONENT_CODE = "importable_component_code"
    20	    DOMAIN_EXCEPTION = "domain_exception"
    21	    GENERATED_IGNORED = "generated_ignored"
    22	    SKILL_ONLY_SHELL = "skill_only_shell"
    23	
    24	
    25	class LayoutExceptionLifecycle(str, Enum):
    26	    """Lifecycle for declared layout exceptions."""
    27	
    28	    M1 = "M1"
    29	    M2 = "M2"
    30	    PERMANENT = "permanent"
    31	
    32	
    33	# LEGACY_PUBLIC_SHIM and DSL_ORCHESTRATOR_SHIM were removed in M2
    34	# after all deferred shims were either deleted or migrated to canonical layout.
    35	_TEMPORARY_LAYOUT_EXCEPTION_CLASSES: set[LayoutExceptionClass] = set()
    36	
    37	_LAYOUT_EXCEPTION_DECLARATION_PATH = "metadata.layout.exceptions"
    38	_CANONICAL_PACK_ROOT_DIRS = {
    39	    "build",
    40	    "docs",
    41	    "elements",
    42	    "examples",
    43	    "executors",
    44	    "fixtures",
    45	    "golden",
    46	    "orchestrators",
    47	    "schemas",
    48	    "skill",
    49	}
    50	_CANONICAL_COMPONENT_SUPPORT_FILES = {"STAGE.md"}
    51	_CANONICAL_COMPONENT_SUPPORT_DIRS = {"skill"}
    52

    54	@dataclass(frozen=True)
    55	class CanonicalLayoutRule:
    56	    """Agent-readable description of a canonical pack path family."""
    57	
    58	    pattern: str
    59	    description: str
    60	
    61	
    62	@dataclass(frozen=True)
    63	class PackLayoutException:
    64	    """One declared exception to the canonical pack layout contract."""
    65	
    66	    path: str
    67	    exception_class: LayoutExceptionClass
    68	    reason: str
    69	    defer_to: LayoutExceptionLifecycle = LayoutExceptionLifecycle.PERMANENT
    70	
    71	    @property
    72	    def is_temporary(self) -> bool:
    73	        return self.exception_class in _TEMPORARY_LAYOUT_EXCEPTION_CLASSES
    74	
    75	
    76	@dataclass(frozen=True)
    77	class LayoutValidationIssue:
    78	    """One layout-contract problem surfaced under the aggregate failure heading."""
    79	
    80	    path: str
    81	    message: str
    82	
    83	
    84	CANONICAL_PACK_LAYOUT_RULES: tuple[CanonicalLayoutRule, ...] = (
    85	    CanonicalLayoutRule("pack.yaml|pack.yml|pack.json", "pack manifest at the pack root"),
    86	    CanonicalLayoutRule("skill/SKILL.md", "optional pack-level skill guidance"),
    87	    CanonicalLayoutRule("executors/<name>/...", "executor capability directories"),
    88	    CanonicalLayoutRule("orchestrators/<name>/...", "orchestrator capability directories"),
    89	    CanonicalLayoutRule("elements/<kind>/<name>/...", "element capability directories"),
    90	    CanonicalLayoutRule("fixtures/...|golden/...", "optional checked-in fixture data"),
    91	    CanonicalLayoutRule("build/...", "generated build output when explicitly classified"),
    92	    CanonicalLayoutRule("docs/...|examples/...|schemas/...", "declared supporting assets"),
    93	)

    96	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    97	# M2-completed: legacy shim exceptions removed
    98	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    99	# These shims were either deleted or migrated to canonical layout in M2:
   100	#
   101	#   builtin/agent_probe.py
   102	#       status:      migrated to orchestrators/agent_probe/run.py (M2)
   103	#
   104	#   video_editing/hype.py
   105	#       status:      deleted (M2) — canonical duplicate at
   106	#                    orchestrators/hype/run.py
   107	#
   108	#   text_analysis/summarize.py
   109	#       status:      deleted (M2) — re-export shim; canonical at
   110	#                    orchestrators/summarize/run.py
   111	#
   112	#   stream_content/__init__.py
   113	#       status:      deleted (M2) — now a namespace package
   114	#
   115	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   116	# Special non-manifest directories (classified in this contract)
   117	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   118	# These directories under ``astrid/packs/`` are not regular packs (they
   119	# lack a ``pack.yaml``) but serve documented roles.  They are listed here
   120	# so the layout contract remains explicit about every known deviation.
   121	#
   122	#   _core/
   123	#       class:       skill_only_shell
   124	#       defer_to:    permanent (not a pack — skill documentation surface)
   125	#       reason:      Contains only ``skill/SKILL.md`` providing the root
   126	#                    Astrid skill description for agent harnesses.  No
   127	#                    ``pack.yaml``, executors, or orchestrators exist.
   128	#                    Discovered via ``astrid.skills.discovery``, not via
   129	#                    ``astrid.core.pack.discover_packs``.
   130	#
   131	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   132	# Relocated / removed directories (validated by contract tests)
   133	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   134	#   astrid/packs/schemas/
   135	#       status:      relocated to astrid/core/pack/schemas/ (M2 T10)
   136	#       contract:    ``test_schemas_directory_absent_from_pack_tree`` in
   137	#                    ``tests/test_pack_layout_contract.py`` enforces
   138	#                    continued absence.
   139	#   astrid/core/pack/schemas/
   140	#       status:      relocated to astrid/core/pack/schemas/ (M2 T10)
   141	#       contract:    ``test_schemas_relocated_to_pack`` in
   142	#                    ``tests/test_pack_layout_contract.py`` enforces
   143	#                    presence at the new canonical location.
   144	
   145	
   146	def is_canonical_pack_path(relpath: str) -> bool:
   147	    """Return True when *relpath* matches a known canonical pack layout entry."""
   148	    normalized = PurePosixPath(relpath)
   149	    if normalized.name in {"pack.yaml", "pack.yml", "pack.json"} and len(normalized.parts) == 1:
   150	        return True
   151	    parts = normalized.parts
   152	    if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0] == "skill" and parts[1] == "SKILL.md":
   153	        return True
   154	    if not parts:
   155	        return False
   156	    if parts[0] in {"fixtures", "golden", "build", "docs", "examples", "schemas"}:
   157	        return True
   158	    if len(parts) >= 2 and parts[0] in {"executors", "orchestrators"}:
   159	        if len(parts) == 3 and parts[2] in {
   160	            f"{parts[0][:-1]}.yaml",
   161	            f"{parts[0][:-1]}.yml",
   162	            f"{parts[0][:-1]}.json",
   163	            "run.py",
   164	        }:
   165	            return True
   166	        if len(parts) == 3 and parts[2] in _CANONICAL_COMPONENT_SUPPORT_FILES:
   167	            return True
   168	        if len(parts) == 4 and parts[2] in _CANONICAL_COMPONENT_SUPPORT_DIRS and parts[3] == "SKILL.md":
   169	            return True
   170	        return False
   171	    if len(parts) >= 3 and parts[0] == "elements":
   172	        if len(parts) == 4 and parts[3] in {"element.yaml", "element.yml", "element.json"}:
   173	            return True
   174	        return False
   175	    if parts[0] in _CANONICAL_PACK_ROOT_DIRS:
   176	        return True
   177	    return False
   178	
   179	
   180	def parse_layout_exceptions(
   181	    pack_data: dict[str, Any],
   182	) -> tuple[list[PackLayoutException], list[LayoutValidationIssue]]:
   183	    """Parse and validate layout exceptions from pack metadata.
   184	
   185	    Returns (parsed_exceptions, issues).  Issues are validation problems
   186	    encountered during parsing; the caller should surface them as errors.
   187	    """
   188	    issues: list[LayoutValidationIssue] = []
   189	
   190	    metadata = pack_data.get("metadata")
   191	    if metadata is None:
   192	        return [], issues
   193	    if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
   194	        issues.append(
   195	            LayoutValidationIssue(
   196	                "pack.yaml",
   197	                "metadata must be an object before layout exceptions can be parsed",
   198	            )
   199	        )
   200	        return [], issues
   201	
   202	    layout = metadata.get("layout")
   203	    if layout is None:
   204	        return [], issues
   205	    if not isinstance(layout, dict):
   206	        issues.append(
   207	            LayoutValidationIssue("pack.yaml", "metadata.layout must be an object")
   208	        )
   209	        return [], issues
   210	
   211	    declarations = layout.get("exceptions")
   212	    if declarations is None:
   213	        return [], issues
   214	    if not isinstance(declarations, list):
   215	        issues.append(
   216	            LayoutValidationIssue(
   217	                "pack.yaml",
   218	                f"{_LAYOUT_EXCEPTION_DECLARATION_PATH} must be an array",
   219	            )
   220	        )
   221	        return [], issues
   222	
   223	    parsed: list[PackLayoutException] = []
   224	    seen_paths: dict[str, int] = {}
   225	    for index, raw in enumerate(declarations):
   226	        item_path = f"{_LAYOUT_EXCEPTION_DECLARATION_PATH}[{index}]"
   227	        parsed_decl, decl_issues = _parse_layout_exception_declaration(raw, item_path)
   228	        issues.extend(decl_issues)
   229	        if parsed_decl is None:
   230	            continue
   231	        first_index = seen_paths.get(parsed_decl.path)
   232	        if first_index is not None:
   233	            issues.append(
   234	                LayoutValidationIssue(
   235	                    "pack.yaml",
   236	                    f"{item_path}.path duplicates {_LAYOUT_EXCEPTION_DECLARATION_PATH}[{first_index}].path ({parsed_decl.path!r})",
   237	                )
   238	            )
   239	            continue
   240	        seen_paths[parsed_decl.path] = index
   241	        if is_canonical_pack_path(parsed_decl.path):
   242	            issues.append(
   243	                LayoutValidationIssue(
   244	                    parsed_decl.path,
   245	                    "declared as a layout exception even though the path already matches the canonical pack layout",
   246	                )
   247	            )
   248	            continue
   249	        parsed.append(parsed_decl)
   250	    return parsed, issues
   251	
   252	
   253	def _parse_layout_exception_declaration(
   254	    raw: Any,
   255	    item_path: str,
   256	) -> tuple[PackLayoutException | None, list[LayoutValidationIssue]]:
   257	    """Parse one layout exception declaration dict.
   258	
   259	    Returns (parsed_exception_or_None, issues).
   260	    """
   261	    issues: list[LayoutValidationIssue] = []
   262	
   263	    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
   264	        issues.append(
   265	            LayoutValidationIssue("pack.yaml", f"{item_path} must be an object")
   266	        )
   267	        return None, issues
   268	
   269	    allowed_fields = {"path", "class", "reason", "defer_to"}
   270	    extra_fields = sorted(set(raw) - allowed_fields)
   271	    if extra_fields:
   272	        fields = ", ".join(extra_fields)
   273	        issues.append(
   274	            LayoutValidationIssue(
   275	                "pack.yaml",
   276	                f"{item_path} has unknown field(s): {fields}",
   277	            )
   278	        )
   279	        return None, issues
   280	
   281	    path_value = raw.get("path")
   282	    normalized_path, path_issues = _normalize_layout_exception_path(path_value, item_path)
   283	    issues.extend(path_issues)
   284	    if normalized_path is None:
   285	        return None, issues
   286	
   287	    class_value = raw.get("class")
   288	    try:
   289	        exception_class = LayoutExceptionClass(str(class_value))
   290	    except Exception:
   291	        valid = ", ".join(member.value for member in LayoutExceptionClass)
   292	        issues.append(
   293	            LayoutValidationIssue(
   294	                normalized_path,
   295	                f"{item_path}.class must be one of [{valid}]",
   296	            )
   297	        )
   298	        return None, issues
   299	
   300	    reason_value = raw.get("reason")
   301	    if not isinstance(reason_value, str) or not reason_value.strip():
   302	        issues.append(
   303	            LayoutValidationIssue(
   304	                normalized_path,
   305	                f"{item_path}.reason must be a non-empty string",
   306	            )
   307	        )
   308	        return None, issues
   309	
   310	    lifecycle, lc_issues = _parse_layout_lifecycle(
   311	        raw.get("defer_to"),
   312	        item_path=item_path,
   313	        path=normalized_path,
   314	        exception_class=exception_class,
   315	    )
   316	    issues.extend(lc_issues)
   317	    if lifecycle is None:
   318	        return None, issues
   319	
   320	    return PackLayoutException(
   321	        path=normalized_path,
   322	        exception_class=exception_class,
   323	        reason=reason_value.strip(),
   324	        defer_to=lifecycle,
   325	    ), issues
   326	
   327	
   328	def _parse_layout_lifecycle(
   329	    raw_lifecycle: Any,
   330	    *,
   331	    item_path: str,
   332	    path: str,
   333	    exception_class: LayoutExceptionClass,
   334	) -> tuple[LayoutExceptionLifecycle | None, list[LayoutValidationIssue]]:
   335	    """Parse and validate a layout exception's defer_to / lifecycle field.
   336	
   337	    Returns (lifecycle_or_None, issues).
   338	    """
   339	    issues: list[LayoutValidationIssue] = []
   340	
   341	    if raw_lifecycle is None:
   342	        if exception_class in _TEMPORARY_LAYOUT_EXCEPTION_CLASSES:
   343	            issues.append(
   344	                LayoutValidationIssue(
   345	                    path,
   346	                    f"{item_path}.defer_to is required for temporary exception class {exception_class.value!r}",
   347	                )
   348	            )
   349	            return None, issues
   350	        return LayoutExceptionLifecycle.PERMANENT, issues
   351	
   352	    try:
   353	        lifecycle = LayoutExceptionLifecycle(str(raw_lifecycle))
   354	    except Exception:
   355	        valid = ", ".join(member.value for member in LayoutExceptionLifecycle)
   356	        issues.append(
   357	            LayoutValidationIssue(
   358	                path,
   359	                f"{item_path}.defer_to must be one of [{valid}]",
   360	            )
   361	        )
   362	        return None, issues
   363	
   364	    if exception_class in _TEMPORARY_LAYOUT_EXCEPTION_CLASSES:
   365	        if lifecycle == LayoutExceptionLifecycle.PERMANENT:
   366	            issues.append(
   367	                LayoutValidationIssue(
   368	                    path,
   369	                    f"{item_path}.defer_to must be M1 or M2 for temporary exception class {exception_class.value!r}",
   370	                )
   371	            )
   372	            return None, issues
   373	        return lifecycle, issues
   374	
   375	    if lifecycle != LayoutExceptionLifecycle.PERMANENT:
   376	        issues.append(
   377	            LayoutValidationIssue(
   378	                path,
   379	                f"{item_path}.defer_to must be permanent for non-temporary exception class {exception_class.value!r}",
   380	            )
   381	        )
   382	        return None, issues
   383	    return lifecycle, issues
   384	
   385	
   386	def _normalize_layout_exception_path(
   387	    raw_path: Any,
   388	    item_path: str,
   389	) -> tuple[str | None, list[LayoutValidationIssue]]:
   390	    """Normalize and validate a layout exception path.
   391	
   392	    Returns (normalized_path_or_None, issues).
   393	    """
   394	    issues: list[LayoutValidationIssue] = []
   395	
   396	    if not isinstance(raw_path, str) or not raw_path.strip():
   397	        issues.append(
   398	            LayoutValidationIssue(
   399	                "pack.yaml",
   400	                f"{item_path}.path must be a non-empty relative path",
   401	            )
   402	        )
   403	        return None, issues
   404	    try:
   405	        normalized = PurePosixPath(raw_path.strip())
   406	    except Exception:
   407	        issues.append(
   408	            LayoutValidationIssue(
   409	                "pack.yaml",
   410	                f"{item_path}.path must be a valid relative path",
   411	            )
   412	        )
   413	        return None, issues
   414	    if normalized.is_absolute() or ".." in normalized.parts or "." in normalized.parts:
   415	        issues.append(
   416	            LayoutValidationIssue(
   417	                "pack.yaml",
   418	                f"{item_path}.path must stay within the pack root",
   419	            )
   420	        )
   421	        return None, issues
   422	    if str(normalized) in {"", "."}:
   423	        issues.append(
   424	            LayoutValidationIssue(
   425	                "pack.yaml",
   426	                f"{item_path}.path must be a non-empty relative path",
   427	            )
   428	        )
   429	        return None, issues
   430	    return str(normalized), issues
   431

     1	"""First-party packs root validation.
     2	
     3	Extracted from ``astrid.core.pack.validate`` during M4 T26.
     4	Validates the ``astrid/packs/`` source tree structure and inventory.
     5	"""
     6	
     7	from __future__ import annotations
     8	
     9	import subprocess
    10	from pathlib import Path
    11	
    12	from astrid.core.pack.validate_layout import LayoutValidationIssue
    13	
    14	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    15	# Known first-party pack IDs and internal directories
    16	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    17	
    18	_REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    19	_FIRST_PARTY_PACKS_ROOT = _REPO_ROOT / "astrid" / "packs"
    20	_FIRST_PARTY_PACK_IDS = (
    21	    "blender",
    22	    "builtin",
    23	    "comfy_wrap",
    24	    "editorial",
    25	    "fal",
    26	    "foley",
    27	    "generation",
    28	    "iteration",
    29	    "media",
    30	    "moirae",
    31	    "reigh",
    32	    "rendering",
    33	    "runpod",
    34	    "stream_content",
    35	    "training",
    36	    "understanding",
    37	    "vibecomfy",
    38	    "video_editing",
    39	    "youtube",
    40	)
    41	# Internal (non-capability) directories that are allowed in the first-party
    42	# packs root: the ``_core`` skill-only shell plus the v10 schema packs that
    43	# own domain tables/repositories (not pack.yaml capability packs).
    44	_FIRST_PARTY_INTERNAL_DIRS = {"_core", "references", "shots", "timeline"}
    45	_IGNORED_PACKS_ROOT_DIRS = {"__pycache__"}
    46	
    47	
    48	def is_first_party_packs_root_candidate(path: str | Path) -> bool:
    49	    """Return True when *path* looks like Astrid's multi-pack source root."""
    50	    root = Path(path).resolve()
    51	    if not root.is_dir():
    52	        return False
    53	
    54	    # Late import to avoid circular dependency at module level.
    55	    from astrid.core.pack import pack_manifest_path
    56	
    57	    if pack_manifest_path(root) is not None:
    58	        return False
    59	    recognized_dirs = {
    60	        child.name
    61	        for child in root.iterdir()
    62	        if child.is_dir()
    63	        and not child.name.startswith(".")
    64	        and child.name not in _IGNORED_PACKS_ROOT_DIRS
    65	        and child.name in set(_FIRST_PARTY_PACK_IDS) | _FIRST_PARTY_INTERNAL_DIRS
    66	    }
    67	    if root == _FIRST_PARTY_PACKS_ROOT:
    68	        return True
    69	    return "_core" in recognized_dirs and len(recognized_dirs) >= len(_FIRST_PARTY_PACK_IDS)
    70	
    71	
    72	def validate_first_party_packs_root(
    73	    packs_root: str | Path,
    74	) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    75	    """Validate the canonical first-party ``astrid/packs`` source tree."""
    76	    # Late imports to avoid circular dependency at module level.
    77	    from astrid.core.pack.validate import validate_pack
    78	
    79	    root = Path(packs_root).resolve()
    80	    internal_schema_errors = _validate_first_party_packs_root_inventory(root)
    81	    layout_errors: list[str] = []
    82	    warnings: list[str] = []
    83	
    84	    for pack_id in _FIRST_PARTY_PACK_IDS:
    85	        pack_dir = root / pack_id
    86	        if not pack_dir.is_dir():
    87	            continue
    88	        pack_errors, pack_warnings = validate_pack(pack_dir)
    89	        layout_errors.extend(f"{pack_id}: {error}" for error in pack_errors)
    90	        warnings.extend(f"{pack_id}: {warning}" for warning in pack_warnings)
    91	
    92	    errors = _aggregate_first_party_packs_root_errors(
    93	        internal_schema_errors=internal_schema_errors,
    94	        layout_errors=layout_errors,
    95	    )
    96	    return errors, warnings
    97	
    98	
    99	def _validate_first_party_packs_root_inventory(root: Path) -> list[str]:
   100	    """Check that the first-party packs root has the expected directory inventory."""
   101	    # Late import to avoid circular dependency at module level.
   102	    from astrid.core.pack import pack_manifest_path
   103	
   104	    errors: list[str] = []
   105	    if not root.is_dir():
   106	        return [f"{root}: first-party packs root does not exist"]
   107	
   108	    child_dirs = {
   109	        child.name: child
   110	        for child in root.iterdir()
   111	        if child.is_dir()
   112	        and not child.name.startswith(".")
   113	        and child.name not in _IGNORED_PACKS_ROOT_DIRS
   114	        and not _is_repo_ignored_first_party_child(root, child)
   115	    }
   116	    expected_pack_ids = set(_FIRST_PARTY_PACK_IDS)
   117	    allowed_names = expected_pack_ids | _FIRST_PARTY_INTERNAL_DIRS
   118	
   119	    for pack_id in sorted(expected_pack_ids - set(child_dirs)):
   120	        errors.append(f"missing first-party pack directory: {pack_id}")
   121	
   122	    for name in sorted(set(child_dirs) - allowed_names):
   123	        if name == "schemas":
   124	            errors.append(
   125	                "unexpected top-level directory: schemas (relocated to "
   126	                "astrid/core/pack/schemas/)"
   127	            )
   128	            continue
   129	        errors.append(f"unexpected top-level directory: {name}")
   130	
   131	    for pack_id in sorted(expected_pack_ids & set(child_dirs)):
   132	        pack_dir = child_dirs[pack_id]
   133	        if pack_manifest_path(pack_dir) is None:
   134	            errors.append(
   135	                f"{pack_id}: pack manifest not found "
   136	                f"(pack.yaml, pack.yml, or pack.json)"
   137	            )
   138	
   139	    core_dir = child_dirs.get("_core")
   140	    if core_dir is None:
   141	        errors.append("missing internal directory: _core")
   142	        return errors
   143	
   144	    for manifest_name in ("pack.yaml", "pack.yml", "pack.json"):
   145	        if (core_dir / manifest_name).is_file():
   146	            errors.append(
   147	                f"_core: skill-only shell must not contain {manifest_name}"
   148	            )
   149	    if not (core_dir / "skill" / "SKILL.md").is_file():
   150	        errors.append("_core: skill-only shell must provide skill/SKILL.md")
   151	    for forbidden in sorted(
   152	        child.name
   153	        for child in core_dir.iterdir()
   154	        if child.is_dir() and child.name in {"executors", "orchestrators", "elements", "build"}
   155	    ):
   156	        errors.append(
   157	            f"_core: skill-only shell must not contain top-level {forbidden}/"
   158	        )
   159	
   160	    return errors
   161	
   162	
   163	def _is_repo_ignored_first_party_child(root: Path, child: Path) -> bool:
   164	    if root != _FIRST_PARTY_PACKS_ROOT:
   165	        return False
   166	    rel = child.relative_to(_REPO_ROOT).as_posix()
   167	    tracked = subprocess.run(
   168	        ["git", "ls-files", "--", rel],
   169	        cwd=_REPO_ROOT,
   170	        check=False,
   171	        capture_output=True,
   172	        text=True,
   173	    )
   174	    if not tracked.stdout.strip():
   175	        return True
   176	    try:
   177	        subprocess.run(
   178	            ["git", "check-ignore", "-q", "--", rel],
   179	            cwd=_REPO_ROOT,
   180	            check=True,
   181	            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
   182	            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
   183	        )
   184	    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
   185	        return False
   186	    return True
   187	
   188	
   189	def _aggregate_first_party_packs_root_errors(
   190	    *,
   191	    internal_schema_errors: list[str],
   192	    layout_errors: list[str],
   193	) -> list[str]:
   194	    """Combine internal-schema and layout errors into a single error list."""
   195	    body: list[str] = []
   196	    body.extend(f"[internal-schema] {error}" for error in internal_schema_errors)
   197	    body.extend(f"[layout] {error}" for error in layout_errors)
   198	    if not body:
   199	        return []
   200	    count = len(body)
   201	    noun = "issue" if count == 1 else "issues"
   202	    return [f"first-party pack validation failed ({count} {noun})", *body]
   203	
   204	
   205	__all__ = [
   206	    "is_first_party_packs_root_candidate",
   207	    "validate_first_party_packs_root",
   208	]
