FILE astrid/core/schema_packs/manifest.py
     1	"""Strict parsing and validation of the 11-field schema-pack manifest.
     2	
     3	Schema packs are the database-schema counterpart of capability packs. Their
     4	``schema-pack.yaml`` is deliberately *not* a capability ``pack.yaml``: it has
     5	its own exact 11-field snake_case contract (``docs/astrid-v10-implementation-decisions.md``
     6	section 4) and never reuses capability-pack semantics such as executor,
     7	orchestrator, element, model, or component blocks.
     8	
     9	Parsing reuses only the shared :func:`load_manifest_mapping` YAML loader; every
    10	field is then validated strictly (exact top-level keys, dependency grammar,
    11	migration descriptors with owned tables, namespaced vocabulary, repository
    12	declarations, and CLI/bridge mounts). The result is an immutable
    13	:class:`SchemaPackManifest` consumed by the composed schema-pack registry.
    14	
    15	This module never opens a database and never imports the capability-pack
    16	definition or validation machinery (m1 plan step 2; v10 section 2 "Boundary
    17	now, loader later").
    18	"""
    19	
    20	from __future__ import annotations
    21	
    22	import re
    23	from dataclasses import dataclass
    24	from pathlib import Path
    25	from types import MappingProxyType
    26	from typing import Any, Mapping, NoReturn
    27	
    28	from astrid.core.pack.manifest import ManifestParseError, load_manifest_mapping
    29	
    30	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    31	# Contract constants
    32	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    33	
    34	SCHEMA_PACK_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS: tuple[str, ...] = (
    35	    "id",
    36	    "version",
    37	    "depends_on",
    38	    "migrations",
    39	    "stream_types",
    40	    "event_kinds",
    41	    "command_kinds",
    42	    "repositories",
    43	    "conformance",
    44	    "cli_mounts",
    45	    "bridge_mounts",
    46	)
    47	"""The exact 11 snake_case top-level fields of a ``schema-pack.yaml`` manifest.
    48	
    49	Any manifest missing one of these fields or carrying any other field is
    50	rejected before any registry mutation can occur.
    51	"""
    52	
    53	MIGRATION_DESCRIPTOR_FIELDS: tuple[str, ...] = ("version", "name", "path", "tables")
    54	"""The exact keys of one ``migrations[]`` descriptor.
    55	
    56	``tables`` declares the tables the migration owns so catalog tests and the
    57	migration runner derive ownership without parsing SQL (decision artifact
    58	section 4).
    59	"""
    60	
    61	_LOWERCASE_IDENT_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$")
    62	"""Lowercase snake identifier used for pack ids, table names, dependency pack
    63	names, conformance dimensions, and CLI/bridge mount tokens."""
    64	
    65	_REPOSITORY_IDENT_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$")
    66	"""Repository declaration names (e.g. ``ShotRepository``) may be PascalCase."""
    67	
    68	_DOTTED_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*)+$")
    69	"""Namespaced (dotted) vocabulary name: at least ``namespace.name``."""
    70	
    71	_DEPENDENCY_RE = re.compile(
    72	    r"^(?P<pack>[a-z][a-z0-9_]*) *>= *(?P<version>[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    73	)
    74	"""The only accepted dependency grammar: ``<pack> >= <positive integer>``."""
    75	
    76	_MIGRATION_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$")
    77	_MIGRATION_PATH_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9_./-]+$")
    78	_CLI_MOUNT_PATH_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\s+[a-z][a-z0-9_]*)*$")
    79	
    80	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    81	# Errors
    82	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    83	
    84	
    85	class SchemaPackManifestError(ValueError):
    86	    """Base error for schema-pack manifest loading and validation."""
    87	
    88	
    89	class SchemaPackManifestValidationError(SchemaPackManifestError):
    90	    """Raised when a loaded manifest violates the 11-field schema-pack contract."""
    91	
    92	
    93	def _fail(field: str, detail: str) -> NoReturn:
    94	    raise SchemaPackManifestValidationError(
    95	        f"schema-pack manifest field {field!r}: {detail}"
    96	    )
    97	
    98	
    99	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   100	# Immutable models
   101	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   102	
   103	
   104	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
   105	class PackDependency:
   106	    """One parsed ``depends_on`` entry (``<pack> >= <positive integer>``)."""
   107	
   108	    pack: str
   109	    version: int
   110	    raw: str
   111	
   112	
   113	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
   114	class MigrationDescriptor:
   115	    """One forward-only migration declared by a schema pack."""
   116	
   117	    version: int
   118	    name: str
   119	    path: str
   120	    tables: tuple[str, ...]
   121	
   122	
   123	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
   124	class SchemaPackManifest:
   125	    """Immutable, validated content of one ``schema-pack.yaml`` manifest."""
   126	
   127	    id: str
   128	    version: int
   129	    depends_on: tuple[PackDependency, ...]
   130	    migrations: tuple[MigrationDescriptor, ...]
   131	    stream_types: tuple[str, ...]
   132	    event_kinds: tuple[str, ...]
   133	    command_kinds: tuple[str, ...]
   134	    repositories: tuple[str, ...]
   135	    conformance: tuple[str, ...]
   136	    cli_mounts: Mapping[str, str]
   137	    bridge_mounts: tuple[str, ...]
   138	    source_path: Path | None = None
   139	
   140	
   141	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   142	# Field validators
   143	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   144	
   145	
   146	def _validate_id(raw: Any) -> str:
   147	    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw:
   148	        _fail("id", f"must be a non-empty string, got {type(raw).__name__}")
   149	    if not _LOWERCASE_IDENT_RE.fullmatch(raw):
   150	        _fail(
   151	            "id",
   152	            f"{raw!r} must be a lowercase snake identifier matching "
   153	            r"[a-z][a-z0-9_]* (e.g. 'timeline')",
   154	        )
   155	    return raw
   156	
   157	
   158	def _validate_positive_int(raw: Any, field: str) -> int:
   159	    # bool is an int subclass in Python; a YAML `true` must never pass as 1.
   160	    if isinstance(raw, bool) or not isinstance(raw, int):
   161	        _fail(field, f"must be a positive integer, got {type(raw).__name__}")
   162	    if raw < 1:
   163	        _fail(field, f"must be a positive integer, got {raw}")
   164	    return raw
   165	
   166	
   167	def _validate_dependencies(raw: Any) -> tuple[PackDependency, ...]:
   168	    if not isinstance(raw, list):
   169	        _fail("depends_on", f"must be a list of dependency strings, got {type(raw).__name__}")
   170	    seen: set[str] = set()
   171	    dependencies: list[PackDependency] = []
   172	    for index, entry in enumerate(raw):
   173	        if not isinstance(entry, str):
   174	            _fail(
   175	                "depends_on",
   176	                f"entry {index} must be a string, got {type(entry).__name__}",
   177	            )
   178	        match = _DEPENDENCY_RE.fullmatch(entry)
   179	        if match is None:
   180	            _fail(
   181	                "depends_on",
   182	                f"entry {index} {entry!r} must match the grammar "
   183	                "'<pack> >= <positive integer>' (e.g. 'core >= 1')",
   184	            )
   185	        if entry in seen:
   186	            _fail("depends_on", f"duplicate dependency {entry!r}")
   187	        seen.add(entry)
   188	        dependencies.append(
   189	            PackDependency(
   190	                pack=match.group("pack"),
   191	                version=int(match.group("version")),
   192	                raw=entry,
   193	            )
   194	        )
   195	    return tuple(dependencies)
   196	
   197	
   198	def _validate_string_list(raw: Any, field: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
   199	    if not isinstance(raw, list):
   200	        _fail(field, f"must be a list of strings, got {type(raw).__name__}")
   201	    seen: set[str] = set()
   202	    values: list[str] = []
   203	    for index, entry in enumerate(raw):
   204	        if not isinstance(entry, str) or not entry:
   205	            _fail(field, f"entry {index} must be a non-empty string")
   206	        if entry in seen:
   207	            _fail(field, f"duplicate entry {entry!r}")
   208	        seen.add(entry)
   209	        values.append(entry)
   210	    return tuple(values)
   211	
   212	
   213	def _validate_dotted_names(raw: Any, field: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
   214	    values = _validate_string_list(raw, field)
   215	    for entry in values:
   216	        if not _DOTTED_NAME_RE.fullmatch(entry):
   217	            _fail(
   218	                field,
   219	                f"{entry!r} must be a namespaced dotted name with at least two "
   220	                "lowercase snake segments (e.g. 'timeline.saved')",
   221	            )
   222	    return values
   223	
   224	
   225	def _validate_repositories(raw: Any) -> tuple[str, ...]:
   226	    values = _validate_string_list(raw, "repositories")
   227	    for entry in values:
   228	        if not _REPOSITORY_IDENT_RE.fullmatch(entry):
   229	            _fail(
   230	                "repositories",
   231	                f"{entry!r} must be an identifier (e.g. 'ShotRepository')",
   232	            )
   233	    return values
   234	
   235	
   236	def _validate_conformance(raw: Any) -> tuple[str, ...]:
   237	    values = _validate_string_list(raw, "conformance")
   238	    for entry in values:
   239	        if not _LOWERCASE_IDENT_RE.fullmatch(entry):
   240	            _fail(
   241	                "conformance",
   242	                f"{entry!r} must be a lowercase snake identifier "
   243	                "(e.g. 'same_project')",
   244	            )
   245	    return values
   246	
   247	
   248	def _validate_cli_mounts(raw: Any) -> Mapping[str, str]:
   249	    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
   250	        _fail("cli_mounts", f"must be a mapping of string to string, got {type(raw).__name__}")
   251	    mounts: dict[str, str] = {}
   252	    for key, value in raw.items():
   253	        if not isinstance(key, str) or not _LOWERCASE_IDENT_RE.fullmatch(key):
   254	            _fail(
   255	                "cli_mounts",
   256	                f"key {key!r} must be a lowercase snake identifier (e.g. 'timelines')",
   257	            )
   258	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
   259	            _fail("cli_mounts", f"value for {key!r} must be a non-empty string")
   260	        if not _CLI_MOUNT_PATH_RE.fullmatch(value):
   261	            _fail(
   262	                "cli_mounts",
   263	                f"value for {key!r} ({value!r}) must be a space-separated "
   264	                "lowercase CLI mount path (e.g. 'shots' or 'shots list')",
   265	            )
   266	        mounts[key] = value
   267	    return MappingProxyType(mounts)
   268	
   269	
   270	def _validate_bridge_mounts(raw: Any) -> tuple[str, ...]:
   271	    values = _validate_string_list(raw, "bridge_mounts")
   272	    for entry in values:
   273	        if not _LOWERCASE_IDENT_RE.fullmatch(entry):
   274	            _fail(
   275	                "bridge_mounts",
   276	                f"{entry!r} must be a lowercase snake identifier (e.g. 'timeline')",
   277	            )
   278	    return values
   279	
   280	
   281	def _validate_migrations(raw: Any) -> tuple[MigrationDescriptor, ...]:
   282	    if not isinstance(raw, list):
   283	        _fail("migrations", f"must be a list of descriptors, got {type(raw).__name__}")
   284	    seen_versions: set[int] = set()
   285	    seen_names: set[str] = set()
   286	    seen_tables: set[str] = set()
   287	    descriptors: list[MigrationDescriptor] = []
   288	    for index, entry in enumerate(raw):
   289	        location = f"migrations entry {index}"
   290	        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
   291	            _fail(location, f"must be a mapping descriptor, got {type(entry).__name__}")
   292	        missing = [key for key in MIGRATION_DESCRIPTOR_FIELDS if key not in entry]
   293	        if missing:
   294	            _fail(
   295	                location,
   296	                f"missing required descriptor field(s): {', '.join(missing)}",
   297	            )
   298	        extra = [key for key in entry if key not in MIGRATION_DESCRIPTOR_FIELDS]
   299	        if extra:
   300	            _fail(
   301	                location,
   302	                f"unsupported descriptor field(s): {', '.join(sorted(extra))}",
   303	            )
   304	
   305	        version = _validate_positive_int(entry["version"], f"{location} 'version'")
   306	        if version in seen_versions:
   307	            _fail(location, f"duplicate migration version {version}")
   308	        seen_versions.add(version)
   309	
   310	        name = entry["name"]
   311	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
   312	            _fail(location, "'name' must be a non-empty string")
   313	        if not _MIGRATION_NAME_RE.fullmatch(name):
   314	            _fail(
   315	                location,
   316	                f"'name' {name!r} must match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]* (e.g. '0001_initial')",
   317	            )
   318	        if name in seen_names:
   319	            _fail(location, f"duplicate migration name {name!r}")
   320	        seen_names.add(name)
   321	
   322	        path = entry["path"]
   323	        if not isinstance(path, str) or not path:
   324	            _fail(location, "'path' must be a non-empty string")
   325	        if (
   326	            path.startswith("/")
   327	            or "\\" in path
   328	            or not _MIGRATION_PATH_RE.fullmatch(path)
   329	            or ".." in path.split("/")
   330	        ):
   331	            _fail(
   332	                location,
   333	                f"'path' {path!r} must be a relative, traversal-free SQL resource path",
   334	            )
   335	
   336	        tables_raw = entry["tables"]
   337	        if not isinstance(tables_raw, list):
   338	            _fail(location, f"'tables' must be a list of strings, got {type(tables_raw).__name__}")
   339	        tables: list[str] = []
   340	        for table_index, table in enumerate(tables_raw):
   341	            if not isinstance(table, str) or not table:
   342	                _fail(location, f"'tables' entry {table_index} must be a non-empty string")
   343	            if not _LOWERCASE_IDENT_RE.fullmatch(table):
   344	                _fail(
   345	                    location,
   346	                    f"'tables' entry {table!r} must match [a-z][a-z0-9_]*",
   347	                )
   348	            if table in seen_tables:
   349	                _fail(location, f"table {table!r} is already owned by an earlier migration")
   350	            seen_tables.add(table)
   351	            tables.append(table)
   352	
   353	        descriptors.append(
   354	            MigrationDescriptor(
   355	                version=version,
   356	                name=name,
   357	                path=path,
   358	                tables=tuple(tables),
   359	            )
   360	        )
   361	    return tuple(descriptors)
   362	
   363	
   364	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   365	# Public entry points
   366	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   367	
   368	
   369	def parse_schema_pack_manifest(
   370	    mapping: Mapping[str, Any], *, source_path: Path | None = None
   371	) -> SchemaPackManifest:
   372	    """Validate a raw manifest mapping into an immutable :class:`SchemaPackManifest`.
   373	
   374	    The mapping must contain exactly the 11 top-level fields; every extra,
   375	    missing, or malformed field raises :class:`SchemaPackManifestValidationError`
   376	    before any model is constructed.
   377	    """
   378	    missing = [field for field in SCHEMA_PACK_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS if field not in mapping]
   379	    if missing:
   380	        _fail(
   381	            "top-level",
   382	            f"missing required field(s): {', '.join(missing)}",
   383	        )
   384	    extra = [key for key in mapping if key not in SCHEMA_PACK_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS]
   385	    if extra:
   386	        _fail(
   387	            "top-level",
   388	            f"unsupported field(s): {', '.join(sorted(extra))}",
   389	        )
   390	
   391	    return SchemaPackManifest(
   392	        id=_validate_id(mapping["id"]),
   393	        version=_validate_positive_int(mapping["version"], "version"),
   394	        depends_on=_validate_dependencies(mapping["depends_on"]),
   395	        migrations=_validate_migrations(mapping["migrations"]),
   396	        stream_types=_validate_dotted_names(mapping["stream_types"], "stream_types"),
   397	        event_kinds=_validate_dotted_names(mapping["event_kinds"], "event_kinds"),
   398	        command_kinds=_validate_dotted_names(mapping["command_kinds"], "command_kinds"),
   399	        repositories=_validate_repositories(mapping["repositories"]),
   400	        conformance=_validate_conformance(mapping["conformance"]),
   401	        cli_mounts=_validate_cli_mounts(mapping["cli_mounts"]),
   402	        bridge_mounts=_validate_bridge_mounts(mapping["bridge_mounts"]),
   403	        source_path=source_path,
   404	    )
   405	
   406	
   407	def load_schema_pack_manifest(path: str | Path) -> SchemaPackManifest:
   408	    """Load and strictly validate a ``schema-pack.yaml`` file.
   409	
   410	    YAML parsing reuses only :func:`load_manifest_mapping`; every field is then
   411	    validated by :func:`parse_schema_pack_manifest`. Capability-pack semantics
   412	    are never consulted.
   413	    """
   414	    manifest_path = Path(path)
   415	    try:
   416	        mapping = load_manifest_mapping(manifest_path, manifest_kind="schema-pack")
   417	    except ManifestParseError as exc:
   418	        raise SchemaPackManifestError(
   419	            f"cannot load schema-pack manifest {manifest_path}: {exc}"
   420	        ) from exc

FILE astrid/core/schema_packs/registry.py
     1	"""Immutable composed schema-pack registry with deterministic collision rejection.
     2	
     3	(m1 plan step 2; decision artifact section 4.) Startup composes exactly the
     4	shipped in-tree packs through one explicit :meth:`SchemaPackRegistry.register_pack`
     5	call per pack, then :meth:`SchemaPackRegistry.freeze` produces the immutable
     6	:class:`FrozenSchemaPackRegistry` that migrations, repositories, and lint consume.
     7	
     8	The registry is a startup correctness boundary: every collision class (pack id,
     9	owned table, migration version and name, stream type, event kind, command kind,
    10	repository, CLI mount key, and bridge mount) is rejected deterministically
    11	*before* any database is opened. This module is pure in-memory configuration:
    12	
    13	- it never opens a database and never imports store/writer/sqlite modules;
    14	- it never imports the capability-pack loader or definition machinery;
    15	- it consumes only validated :class:`SchemaPackManifest` models produced by
    16	  :func:`astrid.core.schema_packs.manifest.parse_schema_pack_manifest`.
    17	
    18	Registration is atomic per pack: all collisions for one manifest are collected
    19	and reported together (sorted, so identical input always produces the identical
    20	error), and no partial state is recorded when any collision exists.
    21	"""
    22	
    23	from __future__ import annotations
    24	
    25	from dataclasses import dataclass
    26	from types import MappingProxyType
    27	from typing import Mapping
    28	
    29	from astrid.core.schema_packs.manifest import SchemaPackManifest
    30	
    31	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    32	# Errors
    33	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    34	
    35	
    36	class SchemaPackRegistryError(ValueError):
    37	    """Base error for schema-pack registry composition."""
    38	
    39	
    40	class SchemaPackDuplicateError(SchemaPackRegistryError):
    41	    """Raised when a registration collides with an already registered entry."""
    42	
    43	
    44	class SchemaPackRegistryFrozenError(SchemaPackRegistryError):
    45	    """Raised when ``register_pack()`` is called after ``freeze()``."""
    46	
    47	
    48	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    49	# Immutable models
    50	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    51	
    52	
    53	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
    54	class RegisteredMigration:
    55	    """One forward-only migration of a registered pack.
    56	
    57	    Flattens the manifest's :class:`MigrationDescriptor` with the owning pack id
    58	    so the migration runner and catalog tests never need to re-derive ownership.
    59	    """
    60	
    61	    pack: str
    62	    version: int
    63	    name: str
    64	    path: str
    65	    tables: tuple[str, ...]
    66	
    67	
    68	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
    69	class FrozenSchemaPackRegistry:
    70	    """Immutable, deterministically ordered view of the composed registry.
    71	
    72	    All mappings are sorted by key at freeze time and exposed through
    73	    ``MappingProxyType``, so iteration order is stable across processes and
    74	    never depends on registration order. This object is the only registry form
    75	    that repositories and the migration runner may consume.
    76	    """
    77	
    78	    packs: Mapping[str, SchemaPackManifest]
    79	    """Registered pack id -> validated immutable manifest (sorted by id)."""
    80	
    81	    tables: Mapping[str, str]
    82	    """Owned table name -> owning pack id (sorted by table name)."""
    83	
    84	    migrations: tuple[RegisteredMigration, ...]
    85	    """Every registered migration, sorted by ``(pack, version)``."""
    86	
    87	    stream_types: Mapping[str, str]
    88	    """Namespaced stream type -> declaring pack id (sorted by name)."""
    89	
    90	    event_kinds: Mapping[str, str]
    91	    """Namespaced event kind -> declaring pack id (sorted by name)."""
    92	
    93	    command_kinds: Mapping[str, str]
    94	    """Namespaced command kind -> declaring pack id (sorted by name)."""
    95	
    96	    repositories: Mapping[str, str]
    97	    """Repository declaration name -> declaring pack id (sorted by name)."""
    98	
    99	    cli_mounts: Mapping[str, tuple[str, str]]
   100	    """CLI mount key -> ``(declaring pack id, mount path)`` (sorted by key)."""
   101	
   102	    bridge_mounts: Mapping[str, str]
   103	    """Bridge mount token -> declaring pack id (sorted by token)."""
   104	
   105	    def pack(self, pack_id: str) -> SchemaPackManifest:
   106	        """Return the manifest for ``pack_id`` or raise :class:`KeyError`."""
   107	        return self.packs[pack_id]
   108	
   109	    def migration(self, pack: str, version: int) -> RegisteredMigration | None:
   110	        """Return the registered migration for ``(pack, version)`` if present."""
   111	        for registered in self.migrations:
   112	            if registered.pack == pack and registered.version == version:
   113	                return registered
   114	        return None
   115	
   116	    def has_pack(self, pack_id: str) -> bool:
   117	        """Return whether ``pack_id`` is part of this composed registry."""
   118	        return pack_id in self.packs
   119	
   120	    def __contains__(self, pack_id: object) -> bool:
   121	        return pack_id in self.packs
   122	
   123	
   124	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   125	# Builder
   126	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   127	
   128	
   129	class SchemaPackRegistry:
   130	    """Mutable accumulator of validated schema-pack manifests.
   131	
   132	    Usage::
   133	
   134	        registry = (
   135	            SchemaPackRegistry()
   136	            .register_pack(timeline_manifest)
   137	            .register_pack(shots_manifest)
   138	            .register_pack(references_manifest)
   139	            .freeze()
   140	        )
   141	
   142	    ``register_pack()`` never opens a database and never consults the
   143	    capability-pack loader; it validates composition-level uniqueness only.
   144	    After :meth:`freeze` the builder rejects further registrations.
   145	    """
   146	
   147	    def __init__(self) -> None:
   148	        self._packs: dict[str, SchemaPackManifest] = {}
   149	        self._tables: dict[str, str] = {}
   150	        self._migration_versions: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()
   151	        self._migration_names: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
   152	        self._stream_types: dict[str, str] = {}
   153	        self._event_kinds: dict[str, str] = {}
   154	        self._command_kinds: dict[str, str] = {}
   155	        self._repositories: dict[str, str] = {}
   156	        self._cli_mounts: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}
   157	        self._bridge_mounts: dict[str, str] = {}
   158	        self._frozen: bool = False
   159	
   160	    # -- public API --------------------------------------------------------
   161	
   162	    def register_pack(self, manifest: SchemaPackManifest) -> SchemaPackRegistry:
   163	        """Register one validated manifest, rejecting every collision class.
   164	
   165	        The check is atomic: collisions are collected across all classes and
   166	        reported sorted before any registry state changes.
   167	        """
   168	        if self._frozen:
   169	            raise SchemaPackRegistryFrozenError(
   170	                "cannot register pack "
   171	                f"{manifest.id!r}: the schema-pack registry is already frozen"
   172	            )
   173	        collisions = self._collect_collisions(manifest)
   174	        if collisions:
   175	            raise SchemaPackDuplicateError(
   176	                "schema-pack registry rejects pack "
   177	                f"{manifest.id!r} with duplicate declaration(s):\n"
   178	                + "\n".join(f"  - {message}" for message in collisions)
   179	            )
   180	        self._record(manifest)
   181	        return self
   182	
   183	    def freeze(self) -> FrozenSchemaPackRegistry:
   184	        """Freeze the registry into an immutable, sorted view.
   185	
   186	        After this call the builder rejects further ``register_pack()`` calls.
   187	        Freezing is idempotent: repeated calls return equivalent frozen views.
   188	        """
   189	        self._frozen = True
   190	        return FrozenSchemaPackRegistry(
   191	            packs=MappingProxyType(dict(sorted(self._packs.items()))),
   192	            tables=MappingProxyType(dict(sorted(self._tables.items()))),
   193	            migrations=tuple(
   194	                sorted(self._iter_registered_migrations(), key=lambda m: (m.pack, m.version))
   195	            ),
   196	            stream_types=MappingProxyType(dict(sorted(self._stream_types.items()))),
   197	            event_kinds=MappingProxyType(dict(sorted(self._event_kinds.items()))),
   198	            command_kinds=MappingProxyType(dict(sorted(self._command_kinds.items()))),
   199	            repositories=MappingProxyType(dict(sorted(self._repositories.items()))),
   200	            cli_mounts=MappingProxyType(dict(sorted(self._cli_mounts.items()))),
   201	            bridge_mounts=MappingProxyType(dict(sorted(self._bridge_mounts.items()))),
   202	        )
   203	
   204	    # -- internals ---------------------------------------------------------
   205	
   206	    def _iter_registered_migrations(self) -> list[RegisteredMigration]:
   207	        migrations: list[RegisteredMigration] = []
   208	        for pack_id, manifest in self._packs.items():
   209	            for descriptor in manifest.migrations:
   210	                migrations.append(
   211	                    RegisteredMigration(
   212	                        pack=pack_id,
   213	                        version=descriptor.version,
   214	                        name=descriptor.name,
   215	                        path=descriptor.path,
   216	                        tables=descriptor.tables,
   217	                    )
   218	                )
   219	        return migrations
   220	
   221	    def _collect_collisions(self, manifest: SchemaPackManifest) -> list[str]:
   222	        """Return every deterministic collision between ``manifest`` and the registry."""
   223	        collisions: list[str] = []
   224	        pack_id = manifest.id
   225	
   226	        if pack_id in self._packs:
   227	            collisions.append(
   228	                f"pack id {pack_id!r} is already registered "
   229	                f"(by {pack_id!r})"
   230	            )
   231	
   232	        for table in sorted({t for d in manifest.migrations for t in d.tables}):
   233	            if table in self._tables:
   234	                collisions.append(
   235	                    f"table {table!r} is already owned by pack "
   236	                    f"{self._tables[table]!r}"
   237	                )
   238	
   239	        for descriptor in manifest.migrations:
   240	            if (pack_id, descriptor.version) in self._migration_versions:
   241	                collisions.append(
   242	                    f"migration version {descriptor.version} of pack "
   243	                    f"{pack_id!r} is already registered"
   244	                )
   245	            if (pack_id, descriptor.name) in self._migration_names:
   246	                collisions.append(
   247	                    f"migration name {descriptor.name!r} of pack "
   248	                    f"{pack_id!r} is already registered"
   249	                )
   250	
   251	        for stream_type in sorted(manifest.stream_types):
   252	            if stream_type in self._stream_types:
   253	                collisions.append(
   254	                    f"stream type {stream_type!r} is already declared by pack "
   255	                    f"{self._stream_types[stream_type]!r}"
   256	                )
   257	
   258	        for event_kind in sorted(manifest.event_kinds):
   259	            if event_kind in self._event_kinds:
   260	                collisions.append(
   261	                    f"event kind {event_kind!r} is already declared by pack "
   262	                    f"{self._event_kinds[event_kind]!r}"
   263	                )
   264	
   265	        for command_kind in sorted(manifest.command_kinds):
   266	            if command_kind in self._command_kinds:
   267	                collisions.append(
   268	                    f"command kind {command_kind!r} is already declared by pack "
   269	                    f"{self._command_kinds[command_kind]!r}"
   270	                )
   271	
   272	        for repository in sorted(manifest.repositories):
   273	            if repository in self._repositories:
   274	                collisions.append(
   275	                    f"repository {repository!r} is already declared by pack "
   276	                    f"{self._repositories[repository]!r}"
   277	                )
   278	
   279	        for mount_key in sorted(manifest.cli_mounts):
   280	            if mount_key in self._cli_mounts:
   281	                existing_pack, _ = self._cli_mounts[mount_key]
   282	                collisions.append(
   283	                    f"CLI mount key {mount_key!r} is already declared by pack "
   284	                    f"{existing_pack!r}"
   285	                )
   286	
   287	        for mount_token in sorted(manifest.bridge_mounts):
   288	            if mount_token in self._bridge_mounts:
   289	                collisions.append(
   290	                    f"bridge mount {mount_token!r} is already declared by pack "
   291	                    f"{self._bridge_mounts[mount_token]!r}"
   292	                )
   293	
   294	        return collisions
   295	
   296	    def _record(self, manifest: SchemaPackManifest) -> None:
   297	        """Record a collision-free manifest into the registry state."""
   298	        pack_id = manifest.id
   299	        self._packs[pack_id] = manifest
   300	        for descriptor in manifest.migrations:
   301	            self._migration_versions.add((pack_id, descriptor.version))
   302	            self._migration_names.add((pack_id, descriptor.name))
   303	            for table in descriptor.tables:
   304	                self._tables[table] = pack_id
   305	        for stream_type in manifest.stream_types:
   306	            self._stream_types[stream_type] = pack_id
   307	        for event_kind in manifest.event_kinds:
   308	            self._event_kinds[event_kind] = pack_id
   309	        for command_kind in manifest.command_kinds:
   310	            self._command_kinds[command_kind] = pack_id
   311	        for repository in manifest.repositories:
   312	            self._repositories[repository] = pack_id
   313	        for mount_key, mount_path in manifest.cli_mounts.items():
   314	            self._cli_mounts[mount_key] = (pack_id, mount_path)
   315	        for mount_token in manifest.bridge_mounts:
   316	            self._bridge_mounts[mount_token] = pack_id
   317	
   318	
   319	__all__ = [

   322	    "SchemaPackDuplicateError",
   323	    "SchemaPackRegistry",

FILE astrid/core/schema_packs/standard.py
     1	"""Kernel-side standard schema-pack composition (core + the three in-tree packs).
     2	
     3	The standard-Astrid registry is the composed expectation used by schema
     4	validation (``doctor`` schema_versions, backup restore validation). Kernel
     5	modules (``astrid/core/**``) must be able to build it **without importing
     6	``astrid.packs``** — the single documented kernel-to-pack composition
     7	exemption is the gateway serve root
     8	(``astrid/core/gateway/dispatch.py``) — so this kernel composition registers
     9	the core vocabulary and loads the three in-tree schema-pack manifests from
    10	the installed package tree. ``astrid.packs.build_standard_registry`` keeps
    11	its own pack-layer implementation (the ``STANDARD_SCHEMA_PACKS`` literal
    12	there is required by the deterministic pack-factoring surgery); this module
    13	is the kernel-side counterpart with the same explicit pack enumeration.
    14	"""
    15	
    16	from __future__ import annotations
    17	
    18	from pathlib import Path
    19	
    20	from astrid.core.events.registry import register_core_vocabulary
    21	from astrid.core.schema_packs.manifest import load_schema_pack_manifest

     4	composition function: it registers exactly the three in-tree schema packs

    17	``DatabaseWriter`` over ``${ASTRID_PROJECTS_ROOT}/.astrid/astrid.sqlite3`` +

    22	is no legacy file/JSONL/FSA/Supabase authority fallback.

    78

    91	def register_standard_schema_packs(registry: SchemaPackRegistry) -> SchemaPackRegistry:
    92	    """Register exactly timeline, shots, and references into ``registry``.

    95	    the immutable registry's ``register_pack()``. Nothing is discovered and the

   113	def open_standard_writer(
   114	    database_path: str | Path,
   115	    *,
   116	    registry: FrozenSchemaPackRegistry | None = None,
   117	) -> DatabaseWriter:
   118	    """Open the single standard-Astrid database writer at ``database_path``.
   119	
   120	    This is the one writer-construction seam for the standard application
   121	    composition (``astrid.application.compose_standard_application``): it
   122	    keeps :mod:`astrid.packs` the single place that constructs the standard
   123	    database/writer (authority lint), returns exactly one
   124	    :class:`DatabaseWriter` (the single write queue), and never opens a
   125	    second writer or a legacy authority. The parent directory must already
   126	    exist; the caller owns the writer lifecycle (``close()`` on shutdown).
   127	    """
   128	    if registry is None:
   129	        registry = build_standard_registry()
   130	    return DatabaseWriter(database_path, registry)

   133	def collect_live_staging_txn_ids(writer: DatabaseWriter) -> set[str]:
   134	    """Return the staging transaction ids referenced by live attempts.
   135	
   136	    Reads ``execution_attempts`` rows whose status is ``claimed`` or
   137	    ``running`` — the lease-holding live states — through the caller's
   138	    **single** writer using the transaction-free read-only connection. No
   139	    second writer, no write transaction, and no new authority is opened
   140	    (m2 plan step 3/4; v10 section 2.3 single-writer rule).
   141	
   142	    For each row the reserved :data:`LIVE_ATTEMPT_STAGING_KEY` value of
   143	    ``progress_json`` is extracted when present. Values that are not valid
   144	    kernel transaction ids are skipped: startup GC is best-effort cleanup,
   145	    so a corrupt progress entry must never block composition.
   146	    """
   147	    live: set[str] = set()
   148	    with writer.read_only_connection() as conn:
   149	        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
   150	        rows = conn.execute(
   151	            "SELECT progress_json FROM execution_attempts "
   152	            "WHERE status IN ('claimed', 'running')"
   153	        ).fetchall()
   154	    for row in rows:
   155	        try:
   156	            progress = json.loads(str(row["progress_json"] or "{}"))
   157	        except ValueError:
   158	            continue
   159	        if not isinstance(progress, dict):
   160	            continue
   161	        value = progress.get(LIVE_ATTEMPT_STAGING_KEY)
   162	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
   163	            continue
   164	        try:
   165	            live.add(validate_txn_id(value))
   166	        except MediaPreparationError:
   167	            continue
   168	    return live
   169	
   170	
   171	def run_startup_staging_gc(
   172	    projects_root: str | Path,
   173	    writer: DatabaseWriter,
   174	) -> StagingGcResult:
   175	    """Run the selective startup staging GC through the standard composition.
   176	
   177	    Collects the live-attempt staging references through *writer* (the single
   178	    database writer, never a second authority) and removes every
   179	    ``.astrid/media/.staging/<txn_id>`` directory whose transaction id is not
   180	    referenced by a live attempt. Managed digest bytes under
   181	    ``media/sha256`` are never touched (SD5), and a missing staging root is a
   182	    no-op. Returns the typed :class:`StagingGcResult` outcome.
   183	    """
   184	    live_txn_ids = collect_live_staging_txn_ids(writer)
   185	    return gc_unreferenced_staging(projects_root, live_txn_ids)

   188	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
   189	class StandardBridgeComposition:
   190	    """Everything the gateway serve root constructed for the bridge."""
   191	
   192	    projects_root: Path
   193	    database_path: Path
   194	    registry: FrozenSchemaPackRegistry
   195	    writer: DatabaseWriter
   196	    projects: ProjectRepository
   197	    timelines: TimelineRepository
   198	    bridge: TimelineBridgeAdapter
   199	    owner_lock: DatabaseOwnerLock | None
   200	    """The exclusive-owner lock held for the composition's lifetime."""
   201	
   202	    def close(self) -> None:
   203	        """Close the writer, then release the owner lock.
   204	
   205	        Mirrors ``CoreApplication.close``: the lock is released only after
   206	        the writer is closed, so a second owner can never acquire the
   207	        database while this process still holds an open writer. Both steps
   208	        are idempotent, so a double ``close()`` is safe.
   209	        """
   210	        self.writer.close()
   211	        if self.owner_lock is not None:
   212	            self.owner_lock.release()

   215	def compose_standard_bridge(
   216	    projects_root: str | Path | None = None,
   217	    *,
   218	    registry: FrozenSchemaPackRegistry | None = None,
   219	) -> StandardBridgeComposition:
   220	    """Construct the standard database and registered packs for the bridge.
   221	
   222	    Resolves the projects root (argument, ``ASTRID_PROJECTS_ROOT``, or the
   223	    default), derives ``${root}/.astrid/astrid.sqlite3``, creates the
   224	    managed-data directory, composes the standard registry (unless one is
   225	    injected), acquires the exclusive-owner lock beside the database
   226	    **before** opening exactly one ``DatabaseWriter`` (the single write
   227	    authority — same m4 law as ``compose_standard_application``), wires the
   228	    kernel services and repositories, constructs the typed project/timeline
   229	    **services** over that one writer, and returns the frozen composition
   230	    whose bridge adapter is backed by those services (plan step 20) — the
   231	    adapter holds no SQL and never opens a writer of its own. A concurrent
   232	    standard-application / kernel-binding composition fails closed with the
   233	    SDK's typed ``unavailable`` error while the bridge is open.
   234	
   235	    Must be called only from the gateway serve composition root. The caller
   236	    owns the composition lifecycle: call
   237	    :meth:`StandardBridgeComposition.close` on shutdown (closes the writer,
   238	    then releases the owner lock).
   239	    """
   240	    root = resolve_projects_root(projects_root)
   241	    # Restore recovery is a read-before-write filesystem decision. It must
   242	    # resolve any journal left by a hard-dead restore before the database
   243	    # writer can open and observe a mixed database/media pair.
   244	    recover_restore_staging(root)
   245	    database_path = derive_database_path(root)
   246	    database_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   247	    if registry is None:
   248	        registry = build_standard_registry()
   249	    # Exclusive-owner lock (SD3-m4): acquired before any writable connection
   250	    # or writer queue can open, exactly like compose_standard_application,
   251	    # so a second writer for the same database fails closed with the typed
   252	    # unavailable contract instead of silently coexisting.
   253	    try:
   254	        owner_lock = DatabaseOwnerLock(database_path)
   255	    except OwnerLockError as exc:
   256	        raise ServiceUnavailableError(
   257	            "the canonical store is owned by another Astrid process. When "
   258	            "astrid serve is running, its bridge owns the store: use GET "
   259	            "/routes and its HTTP routes while it is running, or wait for a "
   260	            "clean shutdown. "
   261	            "Reads may retry after release. For writes, preserve the exact "
   262	            "payload and idempotency key, retry after release, and verify "
   263	            "state.",
   264	            details={
   265	                "reason": "store_owned",
   266	                "retryable": True,
   267	            },
   268	        ) from exc
   269	    writer: DatabaseWriter | None = None
   270	    try:
   271	        writer = DatabaseWriter(database_path, registry)
   272	        # Startup staging GC (m2 plan step 3/4): through the single writer just
   273	        # constructed, collect live-attempt staging references and remove only
   274	        # staging directories no live attempt references. No second writer or
   275	        # write authority is opened; best-effort cleanup never touches the
   276	        # managed digest tree.
   277	        run_startup_staging_gc(root, writer)
   278	        events = EventAppendService(registry)
   279	        receipts = ReceiptService()
   280	        projects = ProjectRepository(events=events, receipts=receipts)
   281	        timelines = TimelineRepository(
   282	            events=events, receipts=receipts, projects=projects
   283	        )
   284	        # The bridge adapter is composed over the **typed SDK services**
   285	        # (m4 plan step 20, task T21) — the same project/timeline services the
   286	        # standard application wires for SDK/CLI consumers, over the one shared
   287	        # writer queue. The adapter holds no SQL and never opens a writer of
   288	        # its own; it supplies the hidden deterministic bridge save key through
   289	        # the service's caller-key slot.
   290	        from astrid.sdk.timelines import TimelinesService  # lazy: pack-owned (m4)
   291	
   292	        projects_service = ProjectsService(
   293	            writer, projects, receipts, projects_root=root
   294	        )
   295	        timelines_service = TimelinesService(
   296	            writer, projects, timelines, receipts
   297	        )
   298	        bridge = TimelineBridgeAdapter(
   299	            writer=writer,
   300	            projects=projects_service,
   301	            timelines=timelines_service,
   302	        )
   303	        return StandardBridgeComposition(
   304	            projects_root=root,
   305	            database_path=database_path,
   306	            registry=registry,
   307	            writer=writer,
   308	            projects=projects,
   309	            timelines=timelines,
   310	            bridge=bridge,
   311	            owner_lock=owner_lock,
   312	        )
   313	    except BaseException:
   314	        if writer is not None:
   315	            writer.close()
   316	        owner_lock.release()
   317	        raise

   369	def parse_schema_pack_manifest(
   370	    mapping: Mapping[str, Any], *, source_path: Path | None = None
   371	) -> SchemaPackManifest:
   372	    """Validate a raw manifest mapping into an immutable :class:`SchemaPackManifest`.
   373	
   374	    The mapping must contain exactly the 11 top-level fields; every extra,
   375	    missing, or malformed field raises :class:`SchemaPackManifestValidationError`
   376	    before any model is constructed.
   377	    """
   378	    missing = [field for field in SCHEMA_PACK_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS if field not in mapping]
   379	    if missing:
   380	        _fail(
   381	            "top-level",
   382	            f"missing required field(s): {', '.join(missing)}",
   383	        )
   384	    extra = [key for key in mapping if key not in SCHEMA_PACK_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS]
   385	    if extra:
   386	        _fail(
   387	            "top-level",
   388	            f"unsupported field(s): {', '.join(sorted(extra))}",
   389	        )
   390	
   391	    return SchemaPackManifest(
   392	        id=_validate_id(mapping["id"]),
   393	        version=_validate_positive_int(mapping["version"], "version"),
   394	        depends_on=_validate_dependencies(mapping["depends_on"]),
   395	        migrations=_validate_migrations(mapping["migrations"]),
   396	        stream_types=_validate_dotted_names(mapping["stream_types"], "stream_types"),
   397	        event_kinds=_validate_dotted_names(mapping["event_kinds"], "event_kinds"),
   398	        command_kinds=_validate_dotted_names(mapping["command_kinds"], "command_kinds"),
   399	        repositories=_validate_repositories(mapping["repositories"]),
   400	        conformance=_validate_conformance(mapping["conformance"]),
   401	        cli_mounts=_validate_cli_mounts(mapping["cli_mounts"]),
   402	        bridge_mounts=_validate_bridge_mounts(mapping["bridge_mounts"]),
   403	        source_path=source_path,
   404	    )

   407	def load_schema_pack_manifest(path: str | Path) -> SchemaPackManifest:
   408	    """Load and strictly validate a ``schema-pack.yaml`` file.
   409	
   410	    YAML parsing reuses only :func:`load_manifest_mapping`; every field is then
   411	    validated by :func:`parse_schema_pack_manifest`. Capability-pack semantics
   412	    are never consulted.
   413	    """
   414	    manifest_path = Path(path)
   415	    try:
   416	        mapping = load_manifest_mapping(manifest_path, manifest_kind="schema-pack")
   417	    except ManifestParseError as exc:
   418	        raise SchemaPackManifestError(
   419	            f"cannot load schema-pack manifest {manifest_path}: {exc}"
   420	        ) from exc
   421	    return parse_schema_pack_manifest(mapping, source_path=manifest_path)

     1	"""Immutable composed schema-pack registry with deterministic collision rejection.
     2	
     3	(m1 plan step 2; decision artifact section 4.) Startup composes exactly the
     4	shipped in-tree packs through one explicit :meth:`SchemaPackRegistry.register_pack`
     5	call per pack, then :meth:`SchemaPackRegistry.freeze` produces the immutable
     6	:class:`FrozenSchemaPackRegistry` that migrations, repositories, and lint consume.
     7	
     8	The registry is a startup correctness boundary: every collision class (pack id,
     9	owned table, migration version and name, stream type, event kind, command kind,
    10	repository, CLI mount key, and bridge mount) is rejected deterministically
    11	*before* any database is opened. This module is pure in-memory configuration:
    12	
    13	- it never opens a database and never imports store/writer/sqlite modules;
    14	- it never imports the capability-pack loader or definition machinery;
    15	- it consumes only validated :class:`SchemaPackManifest` models produced by
    16	  :func:`astrid.core.schema_packs.manifest.parse_schema_pack_manifest`.
    17	
    18	Registration is atomic per pack: all collisions for one manifest are collected
    19	and reported together (sorted, so identical input always produces the identical
    20	error), and no partial state is recorded when any collision exists.
    21	"""
    22	
    23	from __future__ import annotations
    24	
    25	from dataclasses import dataclass
    26	from types import MappingProxyType
    27	from typing import Mapping
    28	
    29	from astrid.core.schema_packs.manifest import SchemaPackManifest

    53	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
    54	class RegisteredMigration:
    55	    """One forward-only migration of a registered pack.
    56	
    57	    Flattens the manifest's :class:`MigrationDescriptor` with the owning pack id
    58	    so the migration runner and catalog tests never need to re-derive ownership.
    59	    """
    60	
    61	    pack: str
    62	    version: int
    63	    name: str
    64	    path: str
    65	    tables: tuple[str, ...]
    66	
    67	
    68	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
    69	class FrozenSchemaPackRegistry:
    70	    """Immutable, deterministically ordered view of the composed registry.
    71	
    72	    All mappings are sorted by key at freeze time and exposed through
    73	    ``MappingProxyType``, so iteration order is stable across processes and
    74	    never depends on registration order. This object is the only registry form
    75	    that repositories and the migration runner may consume.
    76	    """
    77	
    78	    packs: Mapping[str, SchemaPackManifest]
    79	    """Registered pack id -> validated immutable manifest (sorted by id)."""
    80	
    81	    tables: Mapping[str, str]
    82	    """Owned table name -> owning pack id (sorted by table name)."""
    83	
    84	    migrations: tuple[RegisteredMigration, ...]
    85	    """Every registered migration, sorted by ``(pack, version)``."""
    86	
    87	    stream_types: Mapping[str, str]
    88	    """Namespaced stream type -> declaring pack id (sorted by name)."""
    89	
    90	    event_kinds: Mapping[str, str]
    91	    """Namespaced event kind -> declaring pack id (sorted by name)."""
    92	
    93	    command_kinds: Mapping[str, str]
    94	    """Namespaced command kind -> declaring pack id (sorted by name)."""
    95	
    96	    repositories: Mapping[str, str]
    97	    """Repository declaration name -> declaring pack id (sorted by name)."""
    98	
    99	    cli_mounts: Mapping[str, tuple[str, str]]
   100	    """CLI mount key -> ``(declaring pack id, mount path)`` (sorted by key)."""
   101	
   102	    bridge_mounts: Mapping[str, str]
   103	    """Bridge mount token -> declaring pack id (sorted by token)."""
   104	
   105	    def pack(self, pack_id: str) -> SchemaPackManifest:
   106	        """Return the manifest for ``pack_id`` or raise :class:`KeyError`."""
   107	        return self.packs[pack_id]
   108	
   109	    def migration(self, pack: str, version: int) -> RegisteredMigration | None:
   110	        """Return the registered migration for ``(pack, version)`` if present."""
   111	        for registered in self.migrations:
   112	            if registered.pack == pack and registered.version == version:
   113	                return registered
   114	        return None
   115	
   116	    def has_pack(self, pack_id: str) -> bool:
   117	        """Return whether ``pack_id`` is part of this composed registry."""
   118	        return pack_id in self.packs
   119	
   120	    def __contains__(self, pack_id: object) -> bool:
   121	        return pack_id in self.packs
   122	
   123	
   124	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   125	# Builder
   126	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   127	
   128	
   129	class SchemaPackRegistry:
   130	    """Mutable accumulator of validated schema-pack manifests.
   131	
   132	    Usage::
   133	
   134	        registry = (
   135	            SchemaPackRegistry()
   136	            .register_pack(timeline_manifest)
   137	            .register_pack(shots_manifest)
   138	            .register_pack(references_manifest)
   139	            .freeze()
   140	        )
   141	
   142	    ``register_pack()`` never opens a database and never consults the
   143	    capability-pack loader; it validates composition-level uniqueness only.
   144	    After :meth:`freeze` the builder rejects further registrations.
   145	    """
   146	
   147	    def __init__(self) -> None:
   148	        self._packs: dict[str, SchemaPackManifest] = {}
   149	        self._tables: dict[str, str] = {}
   150	        self._migration_versions: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()
   151	        self._migration_names: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
   152	        self._stream_types: dict[str, str] = {}
   153	        self._event_kinds: dict[str, str] = {}
   154	        self._command_kinds: dict[str, str] = {}
   155	        self._repositories: dict[str, str] = {}
   156	        self._cli_mounts: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}
   157	        self._bridge_mounts: dict[str, str] = {}
   158	        self._frozen: bool = False
   159	
   160	    # -- public API --------------------------------------------------------
   161	
   162	    def register_pack(self, manifest: SchemaPackManifest) -> SchemaPackRegistry:
   163	        """Register one validated manifest, rejecting every collision class.
   164	
   165	        The check is atomic: collisions are collected across all classes and
   166	        reported sorted before any registry state changes.
   167	        """
   168	        if self._frozen:
   169	            raise SchemaPackRegistryFrozenError(
   170	                "cannot register pack "
   171	                f"{manifest.id!r}: the schema-pack registry is already frozen"
   172	            )
   173	        collisions = self._collect_collisions(manifest)
   174	        if collisions:
   175	            raise SchemaPackDuplicateError(
   176	                "schema-pack registry rejects pack "
   177	                f"{manifest.id!r} with duplicate declaration(s):\n"
   178	                + "\n".join(f"  - {message}" for message in collisions)
   179	            )
   180	        self._record(manifest)
   181	        return self
   182	
   183	    def freeze(self) -> FrozenSchemaPackRegistry:
   184	        """Freeze the registry into an immutable, sorted view.
   185	
   186	        After this call the builder rejects further ``register_pack()`` calls.
   187	        Freezing is idempotent: repeated calls return equivalent frozen views.
   188	        """
   189	        self._frozen = True
   190	        return FrozenSchemaPackRegistry(
   191	            packs=MappingProxyType(dict(sorted(self._packs.items()))),
   192	            tables=MappingProxyType(dict(sorted(self._tables.items()))),
   193	            migrations=tuple(
   194	                sorted(self._iter_registered_migrations(), key=lambda m: (m.pack, m.version))
   195	            ),
   196	            stream_types=MappingProxyType(dict(sorted(self._stream_types.items()))),
   197	            event_kinds=MappingProxyType(dict(sorted(self._event_kinds.items()))),
   198	            command_kinds=MappingProxyType(dict(sorted(self._command_kinds.items()))),
   199	            repositories=MappingProxyType(dict(sorted(self._repositories.items()))),
   200	            cli_mounts=MappingProxyType(dict(sorted(self._cli_mounts.items()))),
   201	            bridge_mounts=MappingProxyType(dict(sorted(self._bridge_mounts.items()))),
   202	        )
   203	
   204	    # -- internals ---------------------------------------------------------
   205	
   206	    def _iter_registered_migrations(self) -> list[RegisteredMigration]:
   207	        migrations: list[RegisteredMigration] = []
   208	        for pack_id, manifest in self._packs.items():
   209	            for descriptor in manifest.migrations:
   210	                migrations.append(
   211	                    RegisteredMigration(
   212	                        pack=pack_id,
   213	                        version=descriptor.version,
   214	                        name=descriptor.name,
   215	                        path=descriptor.path,
   216	                        tables=descriptor.tables,
   217	                    )
   218	                )
   219	        return migrations
   220	
   221	    def _collect_collisions(self, manifest: SchemaPackManifest) -> list[str]:
   222	        """Return every deterministic collision between ``manifest`` and the registry."""
   223	        collisions: list[str] = []
   224	        pack_id = manifest.id
   225	
   226	        if pack_id in self._packs:
   227	            collisions.append(
   228	                f"pack id {pack_id!r} is already registered "
   229	                f"(by {pack_id!r})"
   230	            )
   231	
   232	        for table in sorted({t for d in manifest.migrations for t in d.tables}):
   233	            if table in self._tables:
   234	                collisions.append(
   235	                    f"table {table!r} is already owned by pack "
   236	                    f"{self._tables[table]!r}"
   237	                )
   238	
   239	        for descriptor in manifest.migrations:
   240	            if (pack_id, descriptor.version) in self._migration_versions:
   241	                collisions.append(
   242	                    f"migration version {descriptor.version} of pack "
   243	                    f"{pack_id!r} is already registered"
   244	                )
   245	            if (pack_id, descriptor.name) in self._migration_names:
   246	                collisions.append(
   247	                    f"migration name {descriptor.name!r} of pack "
   248	                    f"{pack_id!r} is already registered"
   249	                )
   250	
   251	        for stream_type in sorted(manifest.stream_types):
   252	            if stream_type in self._stream_types:
   253	                collisions.append(
   254	                    f"stream type {stream_type!r} is already declared by pack "
   255	                    f"{self._stream_types[stream_type]!r}"
   256	                )
   257	
   258	        for event_kind in sorted(manifest.event_kinds):
   259	            if event_kind in self._event_kinds:
   260	                collisions.append(
   261	                    f"event kind {event_kind!r} is already declared by pack "
   262	                    f"{self._event_kinds[event_kind]!r}"
   263	                )
   264	
   265	        for command_kind in sorted(manifest.command_kinds):
   266	            if command_kind in self._command_kinds:
   267	                collisions.append(
   268	                    f"command kind {command_kind!r} is already declared by pack "
   269	                    f"{self._command_kinds[command_kind]!r}"
   270	                )
   271	
   272	        for repository in sorted(manifest.repositories):
   273	            if repository in self._repositories:
   274	                collisions.append(
   275	                    f"repository {repository!r} is already declared by pack "
   276	                    f"{self._repositories[repository]!r}"
   277	                )
   278	
   279	        for mount_key in sorted(manifest.cli_mounts):
   280	            if mount_key in self._cli_mounts:
   281	                existing_pack, _ = self._cli_mounts[mount_key]
   282	                collisions.append(
   283	                    f"CLI mount key {mount_key!r} is already declared by pack "
   284	                    f"{existing_pack!r}"
   285	                )
   286	
   287	        for mount_token in sorted(manifest.bridge_mounts):
   288	            if mount_token in self._bridge_mounts:
   289	                collisions.append(
   290	                    f"bridge mount {mount_token!r} is already declared by pack "
   291	                    f"{self._bridge_mounts[mount_token]!r}"
   292	                )
   293	
   294	        return collisions
   295	
   296	    def _record(self, manifest: SchemaPackManifest) -> None:
   297	        """Record a collision-free manifest into the registry state."""
   298	        pack_id = manifest.id
   299	        self._packs[pack_id] = manifest
   300	        for descriptor in manifest.migrations:
   301	            self._migration_versions.add((pack_id, descriptor.version))
   302	            self._migration_names.add((pack_id, descriptor.name))
   303	            for table in descriptor.tables:
   304	                self._tables[table] = pack_id
   305	        for stream_type in manifest.stream_types:
   306	            self._stream_types[stream_type] = pack_id
   307	        for event_kind in manifest.event_kinds:
   308	            self._event_kinds[event_kind] = pack_id
   309	        for command_kind in manifest.command_kinds:
   310	            self._command_kinds[command_kind] = pack_id
   311	        for repository in manifest.repositories:
   312	            self._repositories[repository] = pack_id
   313	        for mount_key, mount_path in manifest.cli_mounts.items():
   314	            self._cli_mounts[mount_key] = (pack_id, mount_path)
   315	        for mount_token in manifest.bridge_mounts:
   316	            self._bridge_mounts[mount_token] = pack_id
   317	
   318	
   319	__all__ = [
   320	    "FrozenSchemaPackRegistry",
   321	    "RegisteredMigration",
   322	    "SchemaPackDuplicateError",
   323	    "SchemaPackRegistry",
   324	    "SchemaPackRegistryError",
   325	    "SchemaPackRegistryFrozenError",
   326	]

    46	    """Base error for schema migration ordering, probing, and application."""
    47	
    48	
    49	class MigrationCycleError(MigrationError):
    50	    """Raised when schema-pack ``depends_on`` declarations contain a cycle."""

    52	
    53	class MigrationTooNewError(MigrationError):
    54	    """Raised when the database schema is newer than the composed registry.
    55	
    56	    The probe is read-only and nonmutating; the database is left byte-for-byte
    57	    untouched when this error is raised.

    62	    """Raised when an applied version's name no longer matches the registry."""

    70	    """Raised when a pending migration's SQL fails inside its transaction."""

   103	def sha256_bytes(data: bytes) -> str:
   104	    """Return the lowercase hex SHA-256 of ``data`` (exact byte content)."""
   105	    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

   112	
   113	def pack_resource_root(pack_id: str) -> Path:
   114	    """Return the filesystem root that a pack's migration paths are relative to.
   115	
   116	    The kernel (``core``) declares no ``schema-pack.yaml``; its migration
   117	    path ``sql/core/0001_initial.sql`` is relative to the
   118	    ``astrid/core/migrations`` package. In-tree packs declare paths relative
   119	    to ``astrid/packs/<pack_id>``. Both derive from this module's own
   120	    location so the runner never imports the capability-pack machinery.
   121	    """
   122	    if pack_id == CORE_PACK:
   123	        return Path(__file__).resolve().parent
   124	    return Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "packs" / pack_id
   125	
   126	
   127	def read_migration_bytes(registered: RegisteredMigration) -> bytes:
   128	    """Read the exact bytes of one registered migration's SQL resource.
   129	
   130	    Raises :class:`MigrationError` when the declared resource is missing.
   131	    """
   132	    path = pack_resource_root(registered.pack) / registered.path
   133	    if not path.is_file():
   134	        raise MigrationError(
   135	            f"migration resource for {registered.pack}/{registered.version} "
   136	            f"({registered.name}) not found at {path}"
   137	        )
   138	    return path.read_bytes()
   139	
   140	
   141	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   142	# Topological ordering and cycle detection
   143	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   144	
   145	
   146	def topological_migration_order(
   147	    registry: FrozenSchemaPackRegistry,
   148	) -> tuple[RegisteredMigration, ...]:
   149	    """Return every registered migration in deterministic forward-only order.
   150	
   151	    Pack order is a post-order DFS over the ``depends_on`` graph (dependencies
   152	    first, dependents last), so ``core`` always precedes the timeline, shots,
   153	    and references packs. Migrations within one pack ascend by version.
   154	
   155	    Raises :class:`MigrationError` for unregistered dependencies and
   156	    :class:`MigrationCycleError` for dependency cycles.
   157	    """
   158	    for pack_id, manifest in registry.packs.items():
   159	        for dependency in manifest.depends_on:
   160	            if dependency.pack not in registry.packs:
   161	                raise MigrationError(
   162	                    f"pack {pack_id!r} depends on unregistered pack "
   163	                    f"{dependency.pack!r}"
   164	                )
   165	
   166	    white, gray, black = 0, 1, 2
   167	    color = {pack_id: white for pack_id in registry.packs}
   168	    pack_order: list[str] = []
   169	
   170	    def visit(pack_id: str, stack: list[str]) -> None:
   171	        color[pack_id] = gray
   172	        stack.append(pack_id)
   173	        dependencies = sorted(registry.packs[pack_id].depends_on, key=lambda d: d.pack)
   174	        for dependency in dependencies:
   175	            dependency_id = dependency.pack
   176	            if color[dependency_id] == gray:
   177	                cycle_start = stack.index(dependency_id)
   178	                cycle = stack[cycle_start:] + [dependency_id]
   179	                raise MigrationCycleError(
   180	                    "schema-pack dependency cycle detected: "
   181	                    + " -> ".join(cycle)
   182	                )
   183	            if color[dependency_id] == white:
   184	                visit(dependency_id, stack)
   185	        stack.pop()
   186	        color[pack_id] = black
   187	        pack_order.append(pack_id)
   188	
   189	    for pack_id in sorted(registry.packs):
   190	        if color[pack_id] == white:
   191	            visit(pack_id, [])
   192	
   193	    ordered: list[RegisteredMigration] = []
   194	    for pack_id in pack_order:
   195	        ordered.extend(
   196	            sorted(
   197	                (m for m in registry.migrations if m.pack == pack_id),
   198	                key=lambda m: m.version,
   199	            )
   200	        )
   201	    return tuple(ordered)
   202
